M41A.description: Perfect for shootin' down them xenos.
M41A.name: M41A

TYPE 88.description: A Hwanmokian produced AK74 variant. Comes with a specialty overfolder stock, and absurdly large helical magazine. Extremely poor ergonomics plague this firearm.
TYPE 88.name: TYPE 88

AKM.description: Modernized version of the AK47 rifle with various improvements to handling and functionality. Slightly reduced damage compared to the AK47 with a preference for recoil control.
AKM.name: AKM

COLT ACR.description:
The M16A2E2 ACR was an entry in the original ACR program of 1982 - characterized by the distinct handguard, ambidextrous fire controls, and the use of duplex ammunition.

While the ACR program was ultimately a dud, many of the ACR upgrades went on to see use in other guns.

Low rate of fire and dubious accuracy at range - but high damage through the duplex projectiles.

Model submitted by Rialag
COLT ACR.name: COLT ACR

TAR-21.description: Eretz-Kedem bullpup assault rifle chambered in standard 5.56x45 NATO. Features a long barrel for great ballistics over range.
TAR-21.name: TAR-21

M16A1.description: One of the most iconic weapons from the Kimlan War era which replaced the M14 battle rifle, known for being incredibly light when fully loaded. This rifle uses the early M193 cartridge, meaning its performance differs from modern M855 with poorer penetration and high velocities, but the powder used means recoil and cyclic rate is high.
M16A1.name: M16A1

attachmentModifiers.info: A more modernized version of the M16 stock, first used on the A2 version of the rifle. Improves recoil control somewhat, but also reduces overall handling somewhat.

An experimental heavy barrel and bipod for the XM16E1, allowing for excellent sustained fire & recoil control. Never adopted at scale.

Reduces rate of fire while dramatically improving recoil and damage multipliers.

AN-94.description:
A complex Zarovian assault rifle featuring a unique pulley-driven burst system. Fires two shots in the exact same place before recoil is felt.

Community submitted remodel.
AN-94.name: AN-94

AUG A2.description:
A Nomenslandian variant of the UAR, it is a successor to the F90 marketed for export featuring a redesigned receiver and is compatible with STANAG magazines.
Offers decently high fire rate with good overall damage and a decent weight.

Model submitted by Rialag.
AUG A2.name: AUG A2

HK416.description:
An Eisenmark's depiction of the AR-15 rifle, fitted with a much more robust gas system allowing use in harsher conditions. Greatly renowned for use by Grand Federation Elite Forces.
Fast firerate with average damage and controllable recoil with decent range performance.

Model submitted by Rialag.
HK416.name: HK416

AK74.description: A revision of the Kalashnikov system to accept the less powerful 5.45x39mm cartridge, improving weapon handling and accuracy.
AK74.name: AK74

L85A2.description:
A Soveran bullpup assault rifle as part of the SA80 family!
The A2 variant improved numerous issues and poor quality that plagued on the A1 variant and has remained the standard Soveran service rifle until the recent introduction of the L85A3.
Average fire rate with high overall damage, has jumpy recoil and is heavier than most assault rifles.

Model submitted by Mysterious Modeler X.
L85A2.name: L85A2

M231.description:
The M231 Firing Port Weapon is only intended to be used inside the Bradley AFV in a special mount. Hits hard, but good luck hitting anything...
... You're going to use it anyways, Boss?
M231.name: M231

attachmentModifiers.info:
A heavy buffer tube with a nested spring used in some early XM231 prototypes - dropping the rate of fire to only 200 rounds per minute.

Why would you use this? Why would you want to use this?

G38.description:
A much more modern variant of the M416 seen in use by Federal Defense of Eisenmark, featuring ambidextrous controls with much slimmer profile.
Provides much more barrel length variety with long range focus while being faster than its original counterpart, in exchange for less-manageable recoil.

Model submitted by Rialag.
G38.name: G38

G36.description: A modern modular Eisenmark assault rifle. Originally issued with a special optics package. Middle-of-the-road rifle with a preference for ranged performance.
G36.name: G36

HOWA TYPE 20.description:
A new Tetsujin assault rifle planned to replace the Type 89 which is currently in service.
All around average performance in close and longer ranges. Below average firerate but features a lot of customisability.
HOWA TYPE 20.name: HOWA TYPE 20

AK-12M.description:
Fourth generation of the AK-12 development cycle.

Based on the AK-400 prototype, it incorporates many of the ergonomic improvements of the early generation AK-12s while heavily simplifying production costs and internal complexity. Accurate much like the earlier AK-74M that it replaces in service - so long as you don't touch the dust cover.

Model submitted by Mysterious Modeler X
AK-12M.name: AK-12M

M16A4.description: A modernized assault rifle based on the AR-15 as used by the Grand Federation military, featuring a burst-fire trigger group. Very accurate with low recoil and a long effective range.
M16A4.name: M16A4

QBZ-97A.description:
The QBZ-97A is an export variant of the QBZ-95 designed to use the more traditional 5.56x45mm NATO round.

While it shares a lot in common with the QBZ-95, it possesses a redesigned trigger guard, a deeper magazine well, and the addition of a three round burst mode.

Community submitted model.
QBZ-97A.name: QBZ-97A

STG-44.description: The first successful assault rifle design, firing the intermediate 7.92x33mm Kurz cartridge. Its name, 'Sturmgewehr' translates to 'assault rifle' in English and became the designation for a new weapon type, it by no means was the first assault rifle however. This weapon has great damage in close range, but a slow rate of fire.
STG-44.name: STG-44

AK47.description: A Zarovian assault rifle. The most common rifle in the world, firing a heavy intermediate cartridge. High damage, high recoil.
AK47.name: AK47

G11K2.description:
A prototype Eisenmarkian assault rifle that fires caseless rounds, allowing for more bullets in the same space. It features an incredibly fast 3-round burst mode, but otherwise fires very slowly. It is mechanically complex, making it unwieldy and bulky.
Wait a minute, this is the future. Where are all the phaser guns?
G11K2.name: G11K2

AS VAL.description: A tactical upgrade to the SR-3M, with a large suppressor for the purpose of being used by Zarovian special-ops troops. High damage up close, but lacking damage at range.
AS VAL.name: AS VAL

AUG UNBULLPUP.description:
A strange design of the UAR in unbullpuped form, yet performs identically to the UAR A1.
How does this even work?

Model submitted by Rialag.
AUG UNBULLPUP.name: AUG UNBULLPUP

AK-19.description:
The AK-19 is a variant of the AK-12 chambered in 5.56x45mm NATO intended for export. It is based on the AK-12M, the 2020 upgrade of the AK-12, fitted with a new L-shaped stock and other various improvements to the ergonomics of the firearm. It lacks the burst-fire capability of the earlier models.

Model submitted by Mysterious Modeler X
AK-19.name: AK-19

AK-15.description:
A variant of the AK-12 chambered in 7.62x39mm, developed alongside the AK-12 in the "Ratnik" modernisation program and intended to replace the AK-103 and AKM in service.

Model submitted by Mysterious Modeler X
AK-15.name: AK-15

AK12.description:
The prototype AK-12, first unveiled in 2012, was the final design of Mikhail Kalashnikov before he passed away. It features new ambidextrous fire controls, a novel 3-round 'hyperburst' system, and a heel magazine release amongst various other significant upgrades. While generally considered a fairly significant improvement to the earlier AKs, the AK-12 izd. 2012 prototype was ultimately not adopted due to high costs, complexity, and lack of parts commonality with existing AKs.

Jack-of-all trades gun with a unique burst-fire mode that increases the weapon's power significantly if you can use it right.

Model submitted by Rialag
AK12.name: AK12

IA2 AR.description:
A Selvazian assault rifle designed by IMBEL to replace the FAL and M16A2 in service with the Selvazian military.

Having been designed as an upgrade to the MD-97 - a Selvazian modernized FAL which never entered service - the gun shares many common parts with MD-97 and by extension the FN FAL rifles.
IA2 AR.name: IA2 AR

FAMAS F1.description:
A Lysorian bullpup assault rifle.
One of the two main variants, both were accepted into the Lysorian military in the late 1978s and are being phased out slowly with the M416.
The FAMAS F1 uses a proprietary 25-round magazine with Lysorian made ammo and a smaller trigger guard. It is the slowest firing variant but hits the hardest.
Burst fire reduces recoil by 20% and increases RPM by 100!

Model submitted by Mysterious Modeler X.
FAMAS F1.name: FAMAS F1

M16A3.description: A traditional AR-15 platform assault rifle as used by the Grand Federation military. This version features a fully automatic trigger group. Accurate with low recoil and a fast reload.
M16A3.name: M16A3

AEK-971.description:
A Zarovian assault rifle chambered in 5.45x39mm that features a balanced automatic recoil system designed in the late 70s.
The AEK-971 lost to the AN-94 in selection trials but small batches were adopted for service anyway.
Features a high rate of fire with very low recoil which is lowered even further when using the optional burst firemode.

Model submitted by Mysterious Modeler X.
AEK-971.name: AEK-971

QBZ-95.description:
A shift from earlier Novaruss-inspired designs, the QBZ-95 represents the People's Republic of Jinhan's first domestically developed family of small arms for the new 5.8x42mm round. The design includes a distinctive foregrip positioned just ahead of the pistol grip, improving handling during automatic fire.
 While the bullpup layout offers compactness, the QBZ-95 lacks modularity for mounting accessories - often requiring aftermarket kits to use them.

Community submitted model.
QBZ-95.name: QBZ-95

BREN 2.description:
A modular assault rifle developed from the VZ. 805 with an 11in. barrel. Combines a high rate of fire and a lightweight design to give the VZ. 806 somewhat above average recoil, but excellent overall handling and damage output.

Model submitted by Rialag.
BREN 2.name: BREN 2

C7A2.description:
A Cascadian iteration upon the Grand Federation military's M16A2. Features a full auto trigger group, speedy reload, and an integrated optic.
This gun reminds you of a simpler time.
C7A2.name: C7A2

SCAR-L.description:
A modular Belvaunian assault rifle, built specifically to satisfy the needs of SOCOM. Steady fire rate with low recoil and high minimum damage.

Model submitted by Mysterious Modeler X.
SCAR-L.name: SCAR-L

AUG A1.description:
The Alpenstahlan bullpup universal assault rifle with a built-in telescopic optic. Decently accurate with a long range and above-average fire rate.
Press T and aim to use the long range scope!

Model submitted by Rialag.
AUG A1.name: AUG A1

VHS-D2.description:
A Kravena bullpup assault rifle with a strong external resemblance to the FAMAS.
It deals higher than average headshot damage with a high fire rate, bullet speed and controllable recoil but has lower than average body damage range.

Model submitted by Mysterious Modeler X.
VHS-D2.name: VHS-D2

K2.description:
A moderized Seongho Assault Rifle stemming from the K1A carbine.
The K2 trades close range performance for a long range preference. However, it does lean into close range with its damage done to the torso.
K2.name: K2

BREN 3.description:
A further modernization of the Korvan VZ.806 rifle system with a redesigned upper receiver and various other improvements to the firearm to increase reliability and improve performance.

High rate of fire with relatively good damage, but somewhat higher recoil.
Model submitted by Mysterious Modeler X.
BREN 3.name: BREN 3

MAX-11/15.description:
A Grand Federation upgrade kit for the MAC-11 designed to use AR-15 parts and magazines. Used as a way for the everyman to have a cheaper Automatic Rifle with existing machine guns without breaking the bank.

Model submitted by Vic.
MAX-11/15.name: MAX-11/15

FAMAS UNBULLPUP.description:
A strange design of the FAMAS in unbullpuped form, yet performs identically to the FAMAS F1.
Almost like it was meant as a joke?

Model submitted by Mysterious Modeler X.
FAMAS UNBULLPUP.name: FAMAS UNBULLPUP

L85A2 UNBULLPUP.description:
A strange design of the L85A2 in unbullpuped form, yet performs identically to the L85A2.
Somehow functions unlike a certain L85A1...

Model submitted by Mysterious Modeler X.
L85A2 UNBULLPUP.name: L85A2 UNBULLPUP

L85A3.description:
An upgrade to the Soveran L85A2 assault rifle as part of the SA80 family!
It has been officially issued in 2018 but the whole family is set to be replaced in the future. The A3 variant comes with modifications to the upper receiver and a full-length rail system
Average fire rate with high ranged damage, improved recoil and better handling over the A2.

Model submitted by Mysterious Modeler X.
L85A3.name: L85A3

FAMAS.description:
A Lysorian bullpup assault rifle.
One of the two main variants, both were accepted into the Lysorian military in the late 1978s and are being phased out slowly with the M416.
The FAMAS G2 uses M16-type 30rd STANAG magazines, has a larger handguard and fires faster than the F1 variant.
Burst fire reduces recoil by 20% and increases RPM by 100!

Model submitted by Mysterious Modeler X.
FAMAS.name: FAMAS

AK103.description: A further modernized version of the AK platform, brought into the modern day with a polymer handguard and stock. Trades a small amount of close-range performance for a range preference.
AK103.name: AK103

FAL 50.00.description:
A Belvaunian battle rifle that has rightfully earned the moniker of 'the right arm of the free world'.
Fires quickly with moderate recoil while being very powerful, but suffers from a slow reload!

Model submitted by Rialag!
FAL 50.00.name: FAL 50.00

G3.description:
An Eisenmarkian Cold War Classic, outfitted with a roller-delayed blowback system. It compensates its high recoil and lower rate of fire by handsomely rewarding accurate shots to the head while still punishing poor aiming with its rather mediocre reload speed.

When I go home, they will ask me why I did it or I am some war junkie. You know what I will say? Not a single word.
G3.name: G3

MCX SPEAR.description:
Adopted as the new assault rifle of the Grand Federation, the winner of their next generation competition chosen to replace their standard issue carbine. It fires a high pressure 6.8x51mm round designed to improve upon 7.62x51mm NATO with better recoil control, ballistics, and penetration.

Somewhat lower damage, but makes up for it with a very high rate of fire and acceptable recoil control.

Community submitted model!
MCX SPEAR.name: MCX SPEAR

AK-308.description:
A Zarovian export battle rifle chambered in 7.62x51mm NATO that was developed in tandem with the AK-12 family of rifles, though the earliest prototypes were based on the AK-100 platform.

Lower than average damage, but above average handling characteristics.

Model submitted by Mysterious Modeler X
AK-308.name: AK-308

FAL 50.63 PARA.description:
A paratrooper variant of the FAL 50.00.
While not as powerful as other battle rifles, it is quite lightweight. Strong recoil, high velocity and a decently fast reload.

Model submitted by Rialag!
FAL 50.63 PARA.name: FAL 50.63 PARA

attachmentModifiers.info:
Remove the weapon's stock for better equip, aim, walkspeed, and recoil recovery speed.
Accuracy is hindered from the lack of a stock.

HENRY 45-70.description: A modern take on the classic lever-action rifle, firing the heavyweight .45-70 Government round. 5-round tube, slow muzzle velocity, but instantly kills to the head.
HENRY 45-70.name: HENRY 45-70

BREN 2 BR.description:
A Korvan Republika battle rifle developed from the VZ.806 which uses an atypical 25-round magazines.

Extremely high rate of fire with high recoil.
Model submitted by Mysterious Modeler X.
BREN 2 BR.name: BREN 2 BR

AG-3.description: A Valkarian take on the STG-59H, featuring more modularity and special modifications to specalize in the defense of Valkar. High firerate with powerful but predictable recoil.
AG-3.name: AG-3

SHAK-12.description:
The SHAK12, originally called the ASH12, is a Zarovian bullpup battle rifle chambered for the 12.7x55mm STS-130 cartridge designed to combine high stopping power with relatively limited penetration to avoid collateral damage in urban combat.While it shares a lot of design similarities with the VKS sniper rifle, the two do not use interchangeable ammunition.

Model submitted by Mysterious Modeler X
SHAK-12.name: SHAK-12

M14 BR.description: The last battle rifle issued to the Grand Federation military, it was replaced by the M16A1. It still sees limited service in the military with variants developed into sniper systems, and has been modernised into the MK14 EBR. Loads from a 20 round magazine, with notoriously high recoil, to the point where future models ditched the select fire switch.
M14 BR.name: M14 BR

HK417.description:
An Eisenmarkian battle rifle incorporating the designs of the AR-10 and M416 featuring a proprietary receiver and ambidextrous controls, famous for its worldwide use by police forces.
Packs a punch throughout distance with moderate firerate but makes recoil control and reloads difficult with its bulky ergonomics.
Switch to semi for improved accuracy!

Model submitted by Rialag.
HK417.name: HK417

SCAR UL.description:
A bullpup variant of the civilian MK17 variant that is slightly lighter, modified with a binary trigger grouping.
The binary trigger makes it that a round is fired when the trigger is pulled and another one when it is released.

Model submitted by Mysterious Modeler X.
SCAR UL.name: SCAR UL

BOOMBOX.description:
A Grand Federation Rifle chambered in 8.6 Blackout, meant to take down beasts of any kind no matter the size.
Excellent damage across all ranges with average fire rate while remaining very light weight but suffers from subsonic bullet speed.
Where's the Kaboom? I was promised an Earth-shattering Kaboom!

Modeled by Rialag and Vic.
BOOMBOX.name: BOOMBOX

IA2 BR.description:
A Selvazian 7.62x51mm NATO battle rifle variant of the IA2, designed by IMBEL as a replacement for the FN FAL in Selvazian military service.

Above average damage performance, but poor reload times and somewhat inconsistent recoil.
IA2 BR.name: IA2 BR

SCAR-H.description:
A Belvaunian rifle, favored by SOCOM. Stable, jack of all trades battle rifle. 

Model submitted by Mysterious Modeler X.
SCAR-H.name: SCAR-H

BEOWULF ECR.description:
A fully-automatic rifle in 12.7x42mm based on a heavily customized AR-15 platform.

Extremely powerful up close, but has a very limited magazine capacity and lacks accuracy at longer ranges.
BEOWULF ECR.name: BEOWULF ECR

attachmentModifiers.info: an exercise in free will

HCAR.description: The HCAR, acronym for Heavy Counter-Assault Rifle, is the revision of a classic with new furniture. Intended for the civilian markets, it was made with Semi-Automatic fire only, but we are sure that the good fellas at R&D can put some Betty Boop and give you the extra firepower you might know the HCAR's old man for...if you put in the hours, that is. They only understand violence. So we show them violence. They have heavy caliber infantry, so we have those too. You think we fight this war with sticks and stones?
HCAR.name: HCAR

attachmentModifiers.info: You're joking, right?

RM277.description:
One of the entrants to the NGSW programme. The RM277 possesses a unique firemode arrangement that functions a lot like the M1918 BAR and allows it to switch between high rpm with high recoil, and low rpm with low recoil.
The specialized 6.8mm TVCM ammo this gun uses is relatively poor up close due to overpenetration characteristics. Best used at mid-range.

Model submitted by Rialag.
RM277.name: RM277

USC.description:
Civilian carbine variant of the PDX-45 with a fixed stock and limited ammo capacity to comply with the strict importation rules of the Grand Federation.

Model submitted by Rialag.
USC.name: USC

C8A2.description: A Cascadian carbine with the aesthetics of the CAR-15 M16A2 Carbine. With a high firerate, fantastic close range performance and holds up well in range. However, it boasts a slower reload for its platform.
C8A2.name: C8A2

X95R.description: A modern revision of the Tavor, an Eretz-Kedem carbine, uniquely chambered in 5.45x39. It further improves on the TAR design with improved ergonomics by moving the charging handle and redesigning the stock. High fire rate with better torso performance, but below average damage.
X95R.name: X95R

GOLDEN DEAGLE 2.description: Carbine variant of the Juan Deag pistol.
GOLDEN DEAGLE 2.name: GOLDEN DEAGLE 2

GROZA-1.description: A Zarovian bullpup carbine with roots in the AKS74U, being identical internally to it. It shares the same magazines as AK47 or AKM rifles and was adopted in 1998. Strong recoil, especially with its firerate and higher than average velocity for 7.62x39mm.
GROZA-1.name: GROZA-1

GYROJET CARBINE.description: A prototype variant of the Gyrojet Mark I pistol. Stemming from the Gyrojet pistol, it shares the same loading and functionality of the pistol with a longer barrel, making ranged engagements easier. This particular carbine has the looks of the M16A1.
GYROJET CARBINE.name: GYROJET CARBINE

OTs-126.description:
A carbine variant of the PP-2000 machine pistol made for the civilian market.
However, this one in particular has been modified with the same trigger grouping as the military model.

Large magazine capacity with decently controllable recoil and great ranges.
OTs-126.name: OTs-126

GROZA-4.description: An integrally suppressed version of the Groza-1 firing 9x39mm. Excellent close-range performance with mild recoil, but a slower fire rate and smaller magazine.
GROZA-4.name: GROZA-4

KAC SRR.description: A revolver rifle variant of the RH-44 with a special suppressor also known as 'R-Squared'. High damage, slow muzzle velocity, low recoil, and a fast revolver firerate.
KAC SRR.name: KAC SRR

1858 CARBINE.description: A custom carbine variant of the 1858 New Army revolver. Very high damage capable of an instant kill to the head at any range, with a very slow fire rate and moderate muzzle velocity.
1858 CARBINE.name: 1858 CARBINE

SA58 OSW.description:
A Grand Federation DSA Arms SA58 in the Operations Specialist Weapon (OSW) configuration, which possesses a shorter barrel & modernized furniture for mounting of optics & accessories.

Lightweight with a larger than average magazine capacity for the caliber, but with somewhat rougher recoil and below average damage.

Model submitted by Rialag!
SA58 OSW.name: SA58 OSW

attachmentModifiers.info:
Remove the weapon's stock for better equip, aim, walkspeed, and recoil recovery speed.
Accuracy is hindered from the lack of a stock.

MTS-569.description:
The MTS-569 is a civilian carbine derived from the RSh-12 assault revolver with a longer barrel and integrated stock.

Extremely high damage and recoil with relatively lackluster muzzle velocity.

Model submitted by ILLAXIS.
MTS-569.name: MTS-569

HK51B.description: Aftermarket carbine conversion of the MG80 heavy LMG. Fires at an extreme rate of speed from a 100 round box, but has awful recoil. Has a lengthy reload process.
HK51B.name: HK51B

K1A.description: A Seongho Carbine stemming from the prototype XK1 rifle. Much like the K2 this rifle is quite balanced but leans more into CQC power.
K1A.name: K1A

SCAR SC.description:
The MK16 SOCOM SC is a sub-compact carbine based on the MK16 SOCOM with a 9in barrel firing the .300 Blackout cartridge. The gun is currently in service with some European police forces.

Relatively high damage and good handling, but held back somewhat by a low rate of fire.

Model submitted by Mysterious Modeler X.
SCAR SC.name: SCAR SC

MC51SD.description: Developed for the Soveran special forces. Features battle rifle damage characteristics with mild recoil, slow fire rate, and a smaller magazine than average.
MC51SD.name: MC51SD

SR-3M.description: A Zarovian carbine chambered in 9x39mm, designed for police use. Exceptional close quarters performance, featuring a very high rate of fire with low recoil, but has a smaller magazine.
SR-3M.name: SR-3M

AK105.description: A modernized AK74 rifle with a carbine barrel. Slow firerate with high close-range damage and moderate muzzle velocity.
AK105.name: AK105

JURY.description: A carbine variant of the Selvazian-made Judge revolver. High damage and firerate with harsh recoil and reduced magazine capacity.
JURY.name: JURY

CAR-15.description:
An early development of an AR-15 carbine from the 1960s, featuring an early-pattern 30 round magazine and an oversized flash hider.

Like the M16A1, it possesses a relatively high rate of fire.


Not for use by a senator's son.
CAR-15.name: CAR-15

attachmentModifiers.info:
Load your GAU-5A/A with green-tipped M855 5.56x45mm ammo.

Later used due to being more favourable than M193, M855 has much greater penetration potential than the M193.

However M855 has erratic performance when fired in the GAU-5A/A as bullets tumble in the air.

M4.description:
A Grand Federation carbine based on the AR-15 platform. Burst fire trigger group. Very stable firing characteristics with a high rate of fire. Compared to the M4A1, it has slightly higher damage.

Model submitted by Rialag.
M4.name: M4

C25.description:
An upgraded variant of the C8A4 CMAR rifle which entered service in 2025. Possesses a monolithic upper receiver design that maximizes usable rail space, and generally improved ergonomics over the earlier C8A2 and M4A1 rifles.

Model submitted by Rialag.
C25.name: C25

L22.description:
A small carbine variant as part of the SA80 family!
The L22A2 is outfitted with a vertical front grip instead of a handguard. Around 1500 were manufactured from surplus L86 LSWs and another 500 were built from increased demand.
Increased fire rate while keeping ranged damage high, but the short barrel worsens accuracy and recoil, but also reduces the weight.

Model submitted by Mysterious Modeler X.
L22.name: L22

AK12C.description:
A variant of the pre-production AK-12 chambered in the uncommon 9x39mm ammunition. Intended as a continuation of the AK-9 development, previous prototypes of this rifle were based on the AKS-74U and later the AK-104. Ultimately, it was shelved along with the rest of the pre-production AK-12s.

High damaging especially in close range, but held back by a relatively below average magazine capacity.

Model submitted by Rialag
AK12C.name: AK12C

AEK-973.description:
An improved variant of the AEK-973 which features a new trigger mechanism and an extended padded retractable stock.
Chambered in the powerful 7.62x39mm cartridge while retaining a high fire rate, balanced recoil and high damage.

Model submitted by Mysterious Modeler X.
AEK-973.name: AEK-973

PKP-B.description:
A lighter bullpup variant of the PKP machine gun.
Features two grips where the primary one is upfront for handheld, while the back grip is typically used while prone.
Lighter, with a decent fire rate, great close-up damage but falls short at range and harder to reload.

Model submitted by Mysterious Modeler X.
PKP-B.name: PKP-B

EF88.description:
The 'Enhanced F88' is an Nomenslandian adopted variant of the UAR. It is a lighter weighing upgrade of the F88.
High fire rate with high damage up close while remaining reliable for ranged combat.

Model submitted by Rialag.
EF88.name: EF88

CAN CANNON.description:
An AR-15 with a custom upper receiver and barrel assembly that allows it to use blank-firing cartridges to launch cans.

Pathetically low velocity, but somehow packed with super armor piercing cans that can punch through walls and people alike.
CAN CANNON.name: CAN CANNON

HK337.description:
A shortened variant of the Eisenmarkian M38A5 chambered in the .300 BLK round. While atypical, it never reached mass production by Eisenmark.
Has great close range performance with damage and firerate, but falls short due to its much slower velocity and range effectiveness.

Model submitted by Rialag.
HK337.name: HK337

SUGAR WEASEL.description:
A Grand Federation Rifle chambered in 5.56x45mm, built on an upgraded AR-15 platform. Improved customization and controllable rate of fire.

Model submitted by Rialag & Vic.
SUGAR WEASEL.name: SUGAR WEASEL

C8NLD.description:
An adaptation of the C8 IUR with a distinct stock and handguard design.

Model submitted by Rialag.
C8NLD.name: C8NLD

AUG A3.description:
A further revision of the UAR platform with additional minor revisions. Jack of all trades of the UAR family, but has noticeable horizontal recoil.

Model submitted by Rialag.
AUG A3.name: AUG A3

MINI FIX.description:
A miniaturized version of The Fix - even lighter, smaller, and chambered for .300 Blackout or 5.56x45mm NATO.

Incredibly lightweight and fast firing with a unique bolt that allows it to be operated while aiming through scopes.

Model submitted by Vic
MINI FIX.name: MINI FIX

M4A1.description:
An upgraded and modernized version of the M4 carbine with the SOPMOD I accessory kit installed.
Fully automatic trigger group with very stable firing characteristics, strong CQB performance, and weaker ranged performance.

Model submitted by Rialag.
M4A1.name: M4A1

G36K.description: A slightly shortened carbine variant of the Eisenmark STG-91 rifle, featuring a shorter handguard and barrel. Featuring higher close quarters performance but with a shallow damage slope.
G36K.name: G36K

AKU12.description:
A speculative concept carbine based on the original AK-12 pre-production variant, with elements clearly inspired by the AKS-74U 'Krinkov' PDW.

Strong performance in CQC with good handling, but relatively poor damage at longer ranges.

Model submitted by Rialag
AKU12.name: AKU12

MSG90.description: A ruggedized version of a sniper rifle intended for use in rapid-response operations such as hostage situations. Has a standard 20 round magazine, deep reserves, and a slightly faster fire rate, countered by strong recoil.
MSG90.name: MSG90

VSS VINTOREZ.description:
A DMR variant of the AS VAL intended for special operations where normal sniper rifles aren't viable. Fully automatic capable. Fast fire rate and high damage, with high recoil and low velocity.
Felt recoil is lower in semi-automatic than in automatic.
VSS VINTOREZ.name: VSS VINTOREZ

SKS.description: A modernized Tapco version of the traditional SKS carbine that saw use in WWII. Light recoil with moderate reserves and faster fire rate, but lower damage.
SKS.name: SKS

SCAR SSR.description:
A heavy precision variant of the Belvaunian MK17 SOCOM. Slowest fire rate in class with strong vertical recoil, but with fast recovery.

Model submitted by Mysterious Modeler X.
SCAR SSR.name: SCAR SSR

SAIGA SAR.description:
The Saiga Semi-Automatic Rifle sometimes referred as 'Saiga Sporters' is a sport version of the Zarovian AK family available in a wide selection of calibers!
The base .308 Win. ammo offers the greatest damage especially up close but you can change the caliber for a different playstyle of your choice!
SAIGA SAR.name: SAIGA SAR

MK11.description: A Grand Federation AR-10 platform rifle firing the 7.62 NATO round. Snappy, fast recoil and deep magazine with middling fire rate.
MK11.name: MK11

SVK12E.description:
A speculative DMR development of the AK-12 prototypes and based loosely on the development of the SVCh and AK-308 systems which would follow. The SVK-12 is chambered in 7.62x54mmR and has a fairly typical AK-12 trigger group, allowing it to be used in semi-auto, burst, and full-auto to varying efficiency.

High damage with somewhat high recoil.

Model submitted by Rialag
SVK12E.name: SVK12E

BREN 2 PPS.description:
A DMR variant of the VZ.806 rifle system, firing 7.62x51mm NATO.

Relatively lightweight with strong damage performance and a high rate of fire, but somewhat floaty recoil.
Model submitted by Mysterious Modeler X.
BREN 2 PPS.name: BREN 2 PPS

SA58 SPR.description:
A semi-automatic FAL submitted for Grand Federation military trials. Features a high fire rate and deep reserves, but becomes unstable under rapid fire and reloads slowly.
Will instantly kill to the head up close!

Model submitted by Rialag!
SA58 SPR.name: SA58 SPR

attachmentModifiers.info:
Remove the weapon's stock for better equip, aim, walkspeed, and recoil recovery speed.
Accuracy is hindered from the lack of a stock.

DRAGUNOV SVU.description: A modern semi-automatic bullpup Zarovian sniper rifle with a high rate of fire, but lacking stopping power at range.
DRAGUNOV SVU.name: DRAGUNOV SVU

RUGER 1022.description:
A classic rifle in a classic chassis. While generally better suited at plinking cans or hunting varmint, I'm sure you can make it work.

Model submitted by Vic
RUGER 1022.name: RUGER 1022

BEOWULF TCR.description: A semi-automatic AR-15 pattern rifle chambered in the heavyweight 12.7x42mm cartridge. What it lacks in magazine capacity and recoil control, it more than makes up for in raw stopping power - especially up close.
BEOWULF TCR.name: BEOWULF TCR

MK12 SPR.description:
A 5.56x45mm DMR upper receiver based on the M4A1 and M16A1 platforms. Unlike most DMRs, it retains full-auto functionality for emergencies.

Model submitted by Rialag
MK12 SPR.name: MK12 SPR

attachmentModifiers.info: Standard military-grade 5.56x45mm ammunition. Weaker than the specialized Mk 262 rounds, but has slightly improved recoil and comes with a larger magazine.

AUG A3M2.description:
A semi-automatic variant of the UAR A3 firing the .300 Blackout cartridge!
Low damage and bullet speed but gains power at range and reaches maximum potentional when used at intermediate range before it starts falling off again.

Model submitted by Rialag.
AUG A3M2.name: AUG A3M2

G28.description:
A marksman variant of the Eisenmarkian M417 fitted with heavier furniture and semi-auto trigger group for optimised long range performance, available for military and civilian market.
Delivers decent performance across ranges with a 20 round magazine, but just like its full-auto counterpart, tends to struggle with recoil and handling.

Model submitted by Rialag.
G28.name: G28

M14 DMR.description:
A sniper weapon system made for the Grand Federation army. It is based on the M14 rifle, though lacking an automatic feature.
This is my rifle. There are many like it, but this one is mine.
M14 DMR.name: M14 DMR

SL-8.description: A semi-automatic target rifle with a heavy barrel, sold as the civilian version of the famed Eisenmark STG-91. Very fast fire rate... if your trigger finger can keep up.
SL-8.name: SL-8

QBU-88.description:
Adopted in 1997 by the People's Liberation Army, the QBU-88 represents the first of a new generation of Jinhanian firearms developed for the domestic 5.8x42mm cartridge.

Jack-of-all-trades stats with low recoil and comfortable handling.

Community submitted model.
QBU-88.name: QBU-88

PB GRENADE.description:
The PB Grenade is great for area-denial thanks to its nearly 7 second fuse time, though the overall killing radius is somewhat low. It possesses an extremely high overall blast radius and is almost guaranteed to achieve some kind of effect.
I hear there is a helicopter coming to rescue us survivors from Mercy hospital...
PB GRENADE.name: PB GRENADE

M26 FRAG.description: A Grand Federation grenade that saw use in the Seongho War and preceeded the M67 grenade. Featuring similar performance, however slightly less throwing speed but its shape offers a lot more bounce.
M26 FRAG.name: M26 FRAG

RGD-5 HE.description: A large high-explosive grenade with a short fuse time, making it the perfect anti-personnel grenade. However, the grenade is larger and heavier than average, reducing the number you can carry and how far it can be thrown.
RGD-5 HE.name: RGD-5 HE

RGO UDZS.description:
A defensive hand grenade with the UDZS dual-fuze. It will detonate on impact, but only after a time-delay of 1s has passed. Otherwise, it will function like a normal frag grenade and bounce.

Note: cooking the grenade does not bypass the impact fuse.
RGO UDZS.name: RGO UDZS

M560 MINI.description: A Grand Federation mini-grenade by Accuracy Systems. It was intended to serve as a modern replacement to the then popular V40 mini-grenade, however this series was short lived. Fast throw speed and reasonable blast radius.
M560 MINI.name: M560 MINI

FRAG.description: A traditional Grand Federation grenade. Moderate arc with a moderate blast radius and kill range.
FRAG.name: FRAG

M24 STICK.description: A grenade colloquially known as the potato masher. The stick based design allows it to be used effectively as an offensive grenade. Slightly shorter fuse and slightly below average blast radius.
M24 STICK.name: M24 STICK

T-13 IMPACT.description:
A small baseball-shaped grenade that detonates on impact with a hard surface.

Doesn't do a lot of damage, but you can carry a lot of them and throw them very far!
T-13 IMPACT.name: T-13 IMPACT

DYNAMITE.description:
An explosive developed for mining in the late 1800s, not to be confused with TNT.

Reasonable killing radius and exceptional carrying capacity, but relatively slow to arm and a low wounding radius relative to the killing radius thanks to the lack of any fragmentation.
DYNAMITE.name: DYNAMITE

RGN UDZS.description:
An offensive hand grenade with the UDZS dual-fuze. It will detonate on impact, but only after a time-delay of 1.2s has passed. Otherwise, it will function like a normal frag grenade and bounce.

I'm sure you'll still find a way to blow yourself up with this, right?

Note: cooking the grenade does not bypass the impact fuse.
RGN UDZS.name: RGN UDZS

SEMTEX.description:
An explosive device which will stick to surfaces when thrown. Above average blast radius and throwing velocity.
Cannot be cooked, and comes with a persistent beeping that will alert foes to its presence.
SEMTEX.name: SEMTEX

MK 2 FRAG.description: An iconic Grand Federation grenade renowned for looking like a pineapple. Due to shrapnel it is very powerful in close range. However, like bullets, damage drops off in range, and this shrapnel behaves a lot like that.
MK 2 FRAG.name: MK 2 FRAG

TYPE 77-1 FRAG.description:
A stick grenade developed from the M24.

Extremely low fuse time and above average carrying capacity, but below average roll and killing radius.

This grenade cannot be cooked in the hand.

Model submitted by Vic.
TYPE 77-1 FRAG.name: TYPE 77-1 FRAG

ROLY HG.description:
ANTI, BRING FORTH THE ROLY HAND GRENADE.

First shalt thou take out the Roly Pin. Then shalt thou count to three, no more, no less. Three shall be the number thou shalt count, and the number of the counting shall be three. Four shalt thou not count, neither count thou two, excepting that thou then proceed to three. Five is right out. Once the number three, being the third number, be reached, then lobbest thou thy Roly Hand Grenade of Crane Site towards thy foe, who, being naughty in My sight, shall snuff it.
ROLY HG.name: ROLY HG

V40 MINI.description: A small Havenrijker mini-grenade. This vaguely golf ball shaped grenades small size allows you to throw it to great distances, however you carry more and are less powerful than other grenades.
V40 MINI.name: V40 MINI

BUNDLE CHARGE.description: An Eisenmarkian improvisation of the standard M24 stick grenade. It has six extra charges tied together with a metal wire. This was done to combat lightly armored tanks of the second world war with surprising effectiveness due to its low cost and reliability. However unconventional to carry and a slow charge time.
BUNDLE CHARGE.name: BUNDLE CHARGE

DYNAMITE-3.description:
A bundle of three sticks of dynamite, a personal choice of coyotes and animated characters.

Somewhat larger blast radius than the single stick of dynamite, but still lacks in wounding radius.
The fuse time is also slightly longer.
DYNAMITE-3.name: DYNAMITE-3

JUGGUN.description: A Hip-fire focused Modification Kit for the Stoner 96 LMG. R&D specifically clarified that the ergonomics were going to be completely different from what you have already experienced and, as compensation, fitted your weapon with an even bigger magazine, though....the budget wouldn't allow for said increase to reflect on ammunition reserves. Become War and Draw First Blood....or do like the Town Mouse and live for nothing.
JUGGUN.name: JUGGUN

HORNET.description: UNLEASH THEE BEES UPON YOUR ENEMIES!!
HORNET.name: HORNET

HK21.description: Belt-fed heavy variant of an older rifle. Fires at a high rate of speed from a 100 round box, but has awful recoil. Has a lengthy reload process.
HK21.name: HK21

M249 SAW.description:
The M249 is a Grand Federation military adaptation of the Belvaunian mini-machinegun in service since the 1980s. The gun strikes a balance of being lighter than the M60 while providing better sustained firepower than the M16.

Features an impressively high rate of fire and low recoil, but possesses relatively lackluster damage. Keep away from sand.

Model submitted by Rialag!
M249 SAW.name: M249 SAW

STONER 96.description: A lightweight LMG in 5.56x45mm NATO introduced in 1996 as a simplified version of the ARES LMG-1. The gun's low rate of fire paired with a constant-recoil system give the Stoner 96 incredibly low recoil.
STONER 96.name: STONER 96

MG42.description: The original, the iconic, the feared... The buzzsaw of the axis powers during the second world war, back to prove it's worth in the modern warzone. Fires extremely fast and hits even harder, but is slow and inaccurate.
MG42.name: MG42

SCAR HAMR.description:
Heat Adaptive Modular Rifle - a variant of the FN SCAR rifle which switches from closed to open bolt firing dependant on the heat of the barrel. At first it will fire at 550 rounds per minute, stop firing and the weapon will return to closed bolt. Uncanny stability with poor damage in closed bolt mode. Large magazine capacity making for lengthy reloads.

Model submitted by Mysterious Modeler X.
SCAR HAMR.name: SCAR HAMR

M1918A2.description: The M1918A2, also known as the B.A.R. A .30-06 Light Machine gun that, while not featuring as much magazine capacity as others of its type, still helped carry the Allied Armies to victory during many World War II battles. The most solid, dependable and courageous Marine I had ever known. Blink of an eye....gone.
M1918A2.name: M1918A2

M60.description:
A belt-fed machine gun designed in the 1940s-50s to replace the M1918 BAR, combining elements of the proven Eisenmarkian MG42 and FG42 guns with Grand Federation innovations. Features a relatively low rate of fire with high damage and penetration.
Submitted by Vic.
M60.name: M60

KORD-R.description:
The KORD-R (GRAU designation: 6P62) is a bulky magazine-fed machine gun chambered in the 12.7x108mm anti-materiel cartridge, designed to provide anti-vehicle support at ranges where RPGs and grenade launchers would cause too much collateral damage while also being easier to deploy than a traditional HMG gun emplacement. In early trials, it was quickly found to be impractical due to the weight and limited use cases.

Has extremely poor handling and recoil control, but unmatched damage potential.
KORD-R.name: KORD-R

MG3KWS.description: A belt-fed Eisenmarkian LMG with roots dating back to the MG42. Fastest fire rate, but has a 50 round magazine, lower damage, and a lengthy reload process.
MG3KWS.name: MG3KWS

L86 LSW.description:
A heavyweight squad weapon variant as part of the SA80 family!
The increased barrel length and bipod gives this weapon improved accuracy, increased muzzle velocity and greater effective range. It was withdrawn in 2019 after being confirmed the L86 would not receive further upgrades.
Increased fire rate with high damage, penetration and bullet speed but suffers from heavy weight and a slow reload time.

Model submitted by Mysterious Modeler X.
L86 LSW.name: L86 LSW

RPK.description: A heavy variant of the AK47 with a more durable receiver and heavy barrel. Packs a punch, but fires slowly, with strong recoil.
RPK.name: RPK

RPK12.description:
A speculative light machine gun based off of the AK-12 pre-production variant, likely intended to replace the RPK-74. While a mockup of the gun is said to exist, there are no official images of it. It was likely abandoned in favour of the RPK-16 platform early in development.

Relatively average performance across the board.

Model submitted by Rialag
RPK12.name: RPK12

M27 IAR.description:
A much ruggedized variant of the Eisenmarkian M416 adopted by Grand Federation in role of a Squad Automatic Weapon issued to troops.
Sustainable firerate with manageable accuracy due to a heavier barrel and extra reserve ammo, but also suffers from lower-than-average power and magazine size in class.
''I have been trained by your Government to be a weapon. Trained to kill and destroy. All in the name of Liberty and Justice.''

Model submitted by Rialag.
M27 IAR.name: M27 IAR

attachmentModifiers.info:
A larger 60 round drum magazine!
Doubles your magazine capacity at the cost of handling, mobility and reload time!

GOLDEN HK51B.description: A special variant of the LMG BLING from a crystal like material that makes it bling in beauty! Uses .308 Winchester as stock ammo but the casings can be filled with many types of gemstones with each having special unique effects! Which gemstone will you main?
GOLDEN HK51B.name: GOLDEN HK51B

MGV-176.description:
A Slovenian modernization of the Grand Federation 180. Chambered in .22LR and with a mag size of 161, this weapon fires accurately at an excruciating high fire rate. Although, with its mediocre damage values, its insane rate of fire more than makes up for it.
Make anyone you shoot yell out 'No, Not the Bees!?!!'
MGV-176.name: MGV-176

PKP.description:
A further modification of the Zarovian PKM.
Uses a heavier, partially forced-air-cooled barrel with radial cooling ribs to keep the barrel cooler while having an increased fire rate.
High damage with a fast fire rate but difficult to control.

Model submitted by Mysterious Modeler X.
PKP.name: PKP

AK12BR.description:
The AK-12BR (for "Balanced Recoil") is a 5.45x39mm AK-12 prototype using a BARS system and a highly unconventional 'snail' drum magazine. No known development of the AK-12s with BARS exists, and the AK-12 prototypes were abandoned long before any such development could've taken place. 

High rate of fire and incredible gun stability, but very low damage.

Model submitted by Rialag
AK12BR.name: AK12BR

RPK74.description: An updated variant of the RPK based off the AK74, intended to use the less powerful 5.45x39mm cartridge for greater recoil control and better performance overall.
RPK74.name: RPK74

AEK-999.description:
A modernized version of the PKM developed during the 90s with the goal to improve its capabilities as a LMG/SAW role.
The AEK-999 was capable of sustained fire without requiring a quick-change barrel and is remarkably accurate with hipfiring or when held by the bipod. It however lost in military trials to the PKP Pecheneg.
Average fire rate with above-average hipfire control and comes with a suppressor equipped at all times.

Model submitted by Mysterious Modeler X.
AEK-999.name: AEK-999

ChainSAW.description: An unconventional ergonomic conversion kit for the Stoner 96, designed to be fired from the hip and held like a chainsaw. While various methods were tested to aid the user's accuracy, none made the ChainSAW's accuracy consistent enough to push it past the prototype stage. Possesses decent damage with good mobility and an incredibly high belt-fed magazine capacity, giving the gun extremely consistent damage output - even if it's not the most accurate.
ChainSAW.name: ChainSAW

COLT LMG.description: A Dakarheim-designated squad automatic weapon based on the AR-15 platform with a heavy barrel, large heat shroud, and 60-round magazine. A jack-of-all-trades with a somewhat slow reload.
COLT LMG.name: COLT LMG

MG36.description: A heavy-barrel variant of the Eisenmark STG-91 rifle, using 100-round beta c-mags. Low damage, but has a high fire rate and low recoil.
MG36.name: MG36

FALO 50.41.description:
An early Cold War Belvaunian LMG based off of the FAL, possessing a heavy barrel and shorter handguard for improved cooling.

The gun was replaced in service with the more capable FN MAG due to various reliability and controllability issues present with the FALO.

Possesses a below-average magazine capacity and somewhat mediocre handling, but very high damage.

Model submitted by Rialag!
FALO 50.41.name: FALO 50.41

PKM.description:
A heavy Zarovian belt-fed machine gun designed in the 60s, a modernized, product-improved version of the PK.
Uses the powerful 7.62x54mmR cartridge designed to rip through enemies with a relatively low fire rate and average recoil control.

Model submitted by Mysterious Modeler X.
PKM.name: PKM

AUG HBAR.description:
A heavy-barrel, open-bolt variant of the UAR, with a slightly slower fire rate and larger magazine. Accurate, but with a slow reload.

Model submitted by Rialag.
AUG HBAR.name: AUG HBAR

REAPR.description:
A .338 Lapua Magnum 'lightweight' machine gun concept, designed to be lighter and more portable than traditional MMGs without sacrificing any stopping power. The entire rifle can be taken apart and stored in a standard sized backpack.

Possesses extremely high damage potential, but has a somewhat low rate of fire and only 20 rounds per belt.

Model submitted by MMX.
REAPR.name: REAPR

QJB-95 LSW.description:
The QJB-95 LSW, formerly known as the QBB-95, is an LMG variant of the QBZ-95 characterized by the longer, heavier barrel and the addition of a bipod.

The gun also uses a heavier 5.8x42mm round with improved ballistics and penetration compared to the standard ones used in the QBZ-95.

Community submitted model.
QJB-95 LSW.name: QJB-95 LSW

RPK-16.description:
A Zarovian LMG derived from the RPK-400, replacing the RPK and RPK-74 in service. It fires 5.45x39mm ammo out of a 95-round drum magazine, but can also use older RPK-74 magazines.

Very high sustain with relatively moderate damage and somewhat high recoil. Minor risk of betrayal.

Model submitted by Mysterious Modeler X
RPK-16.name: RPK-16

GLOCK 18.description: A 9mm Alpenstahlan machine pistol. Fast fire rate with relatively stable handling characteristics.
GLOCK 18.name: GLOCK 18

SKORPION.description: Korvan Republika machine pistol of iconic design made in 1959 by Miroslav Rybář. It does have faults but at the same it is reliable with low recoil and good damage in close ranges.
SKORPION.name: SKORPION

AEK-919K.description:
A Zarovian machine pistol chambered for the 9x18mm cartridge.
Lightweight and accurate with an average fire rate while having good ranged damage performance.

Model submitted by Mysterious Modeler X.
AEK-919K.name: AEK-919K

MICRO UZI.description: A compact version of the Uzi, favored by criminals of all walks. Fires at an incredibly high rate of fire, but mind the ammo.
MICRO UZI.name: MICRO UZI

ASMI.description: A machine pistol developed for the Sindhara Army, made with 3D printing technology as part of its construction. Possessing a relatively low rate of fire and low damage, however this is made up for it with a high magazine capacity and an above average headshot multiplier. Serving as a good jack-of-all-trades secondary.
ASMI.name: ASMI

ARM PISTOL.description:
The Bushmaster Arm Pistol is legally classified as a bullpup pistol, but is also classified as a compact carbine.
Featuring a unique design which allows the user to rotate the reciever to their preferred orientation. This firearm featured a tipping-block bolt system, which was combined with a long stroke piston system similar to the AK47 alongside sharing common parts to the AR-15, good damage in close range which quickly falls off, poor accuracy.
ARM PISTOL.name: ARM PISTOL

AUTO 9.description: Dead or alive, you're coming with me.
AUTO 9.name: AUTO 9

M93R.description: An Roma Invicta machine pistol that fires rapid 3-round bursts. Strong vertical recoil with high close-in damage.
M93R.name: M93R

PP-2000.description: Iconic Zarovian machine pistol chambering special +P+ overpressure ammunition. Slow rate of fire and somewhat high recoil, but good damage and penetration characteristics.
PP-2000.name: PP-2000

TEC-9.description:
An open-bolt pistol developed as a simplified version of the MP-9 SMG for Grand Federation markets. While normally semi-automatic, this TEC-9 has been modified to fire in full-auto again - just like the MP-9 it is based on! High recoil and low damage, but a blisteringly fast rate of fire.

Model submitted by Vic.
TEC-9.name: TEC-9

MAC11.description:
An iconic Grand Federation Open-Bolt SMG, chambered in .380 ACP. Used by the good guys and the bad guys in hundreds of films, this SMG has also seen military and police use throughout the world. Rapid-fire with some stability.

Model submitted by Vic.
MAC11.name: MAC11

MP1911.description: A custom 1911 prototype from Maharlika. Features a custom foregrip and muzzle device for very stable firing characteristics, but has a bulky magazine resulting in slow reloads.
MP1911.name: MP1911

CLEAVER.description: A heavy butcher knife intended to hack through tough bone, such as in the preparation of meat. Faster swing time.
CLEAVER.name: CLEAVER

ENTRENCHER.description: A perfect tool for flying soldiers.Model by Victor.
ENTRENCHER.name: ENTRENCHER

STREITER.description:
The power of god and anime is on your side.
Mass produced carbon sword with minimal design to optimize results. The quick stab is a simple punch, don't question why it's as powerful as the blade swings!
Model by Vic.
STREITER.name: STREITER

TANZANITE BLADE.description: A truly retro sword crafted from jewels. Great for knocking out giant green exploding monsters. Halloween 2020 Melee.
TANZANITE BLADE.name: TANZANITE BLADE

GOSPELL BLADE.description:
Blade of the chapel in the northen keep, forged from the laughing skull explosive and thick ice, held together through elven magic. The blade is used to slay those who fight against the teachings of the cold god.
Model by Microsushi.
GOSPELL BLADE.name: GOSPELL BLADE

HAVOC BLADE.description:
An exotic blade that only the most seasoned of soldier can wield properly. Large blade, large damage.
A reward for sticking with us for so long, thank you.
Model by ILLAXIS.
HAVOC BLADE.name: HAVOC BLADE

TANTO.description: Despite how it looks, it's actually classified as a short sword. Originally used as weapons they slowly became more of a mantle piece than for actual combat.
TANTO.name: TANTO

DARKHEART.description:
Scepter born of evil. Blade of night that only appears when you swing it. It's power is immense but it's unwieldy to use. Can your mortal form even handle it?
Halloween 2020 Melee.
Model by Vic + Mako.
DARKHEART.name: DARKHEART

JKEY.description:
A special reward for your participation in the 2018 Ready Player One event. Very short range with fast swing time.
... Escape your past and the key will be yours at last.
JKEY.name: JKEY

TRENCH KNIFE.description: A classic Grand Federation blade used in the second world war. The blades were easy to break so the weapon was also made with knuckles in case of those situations.
TRENCH KNIFE.name: TRENCH KNIFE

KRAMPUS KUKRI.description:
A blade forged from black ice, tempered with the fires of hate from a vengeful christmas spirit.
Does the most damage striking at the heart.
Holiday 2020 Melee made by ILLAXIS.
KRAMPUS KUKRI.name: KRAMPUS KUKRI

COOKIE CUTTER.description:
If a Gingerbread man is inside of a Gingerbread house, would the house be made out of flesh or might the Gingerbread man be made out of home?

MERRY CHRISTMAS EVERYONE! (2023)
COOKIE CUTTER.name: COOKIE CUTTER

KUNAI.description: Find your ninja way and defeat your foes. These were utilized by ninjas in ancient times both as close combat weapons as well as throwing knives. Sadly your training only allows the former. Short range, quick attacks. Believe it!
KUNAI.name: KUNAI

RITUAL SICKLE.description:
An elaborate but crudely made sacrificial sickle weapon used by the cultists as both a self defense weapon... and for horrible rituals.
Original model by Poodros.
Halloween 2020 Melee.
RITUAL SICKLE.name: RITUAL SICKLE

BALISONG.description: A modern incarnation of a classic Maharlikan knife, known for its use for tricks and just overall looking cool. Got any tricks to share?
BALISONG.name: BALISONG

LINKED SWORD.description:
The classic, the original.
Basic attacks are quick slashes with short range. Alt attacks are thrusts with great range but long cooldown.
LINKED SWORD.name: LINKED SWORD

ICE PICK.description:
A pick designed for cutting into packed ice, useful for scaling cliffs and glaciers alike. It might have been used by a free man once, in another timeline. Longer range.
Model by Shay.
ICE PICK.name: ICE PICK

UTILITY KNIFE.description:
A Helzevia army knife with many useful tools one could flip out for any number of situations.
Tiny blade, fast speed.
Halloween 2020 Melee.
UTILITY KNIFE.name: UTILITY KNIFE

TOON BLADE.description:
It's dangerous to go alone! Not sure how much a toy sword will help, but take it anyway?
April Fools 2024 melee.

Model by Duo.
TOON BLADE.name: TOON BLADE

HRUNTING.description:
Pronounced 'Runting'.
An ancient english blade spewing with venomous fire, does the most damage to the heart.
Model by Darkman_Bree.
HRUNTING.name: HRUNTING

CUTTER.description:
It's pizza time.
Small cutting instrument with a rotating circular blade making it perfect for cutting pizza, people though are harder to cut.
Does the best damage against arms and legs. Made by Darkman_Bree.
CUTTER.name: CUTTER

MACHETE.description:
A Zarovian machete intended for the taiga. A certain GRU agent might have used this very style of machete. Longer range.
A chain is only as strong as its weakest link.
MACHETE.name: MACHETE

TOMAHAWK.description:
A small axe useful for surviving in the wilderness, even after your plane goes down. Maybe it's time you bury the hatchet with your opponent. Fast swing time with shorter range.
Model by Shay.
TOMAHAWK.name: TOMAHAWK

MEK'LETH.description:
A strangely shaped melee weapon, made out of a tough alloy. While it may be cumbersome for a human, a particularly strong alien could make great use of this. Longer range.
Qaplaʼ!
MEK'LETH.name: MEK'LETH

KNIFE.description: A Grand Federation bayonet knife, with many purposes. Essentially the baseline for all melees.
KNIFE.name: KNIFE

KEY.description: Wait, are these your keys? House keys, car keys, closet keys, basement keys... WHOSE KEYS ARE THESE AND WHAT DO THEY OPEN?!
KEY.name: KEY

KARAMBIT R.description:
A sharply curved Indonesian knife, popular as both a utility and combat knife. Very short range with high damage.
Remodel by ILLAXIS.
KARAMBIT R.name: KARAMBIT R

ICICLE.description: A cursed spike of ice that will extend out when the user desires it to. Use it to freezze the cold heart of scrooges.
ICICLE.name: ICICLE

BRIDAL BRANDISHER.description:
A rapier bathed in the blood of a father murderer.
Great reach, great power. Requires patience to master.
Model by Shelby.
BRIDAL BRANDISHER.name: BRIDAL BRANDISHER

WAR FAN.description: A traditional fan hiding a deadly blade, quick to move and slice, especially deadly towards the head.
WAR FAN.name: WAR FAN

JASON.description:
A traditional machete with a lot of history and more than its fair share of combat. All you need now is a hockey mask. Functionally identical to the Machete.
Chh-chh-chh, ahh-ahh-ahh...
JASON.name: JASON

CLASSIC KNIFE.description: Wow, you really made it past rank 200? You're awesome, thank you so much from the StyLiS dev team for playing and supporting our game for so long.
CLASSIC KNIFE.name: CLASSIC KNIFE

KAMA.description:
A traditionally Asian farming tool used for reaping crops and the blood of your enemies.
Model by Shelby.
KAMA.name: KAMA

NATA HATCHET.description: A multipurpose hatchet useful for pruning small bushes and debarking trees. The accursed blade sings gently like the higurashi, carrying on its tune the curse of a girl who turned her back on her friends as she was overcome by madness. It remains possessed by that fragment of misery to this day.
NATA HATCHET.name: NATA HATCHET

HUNTING KNIFE.description:
A classic hunting knife made with modern materials. It feels perfectly weighted in your hand. Trades some range and swing speed for damage.
What's your favorite scary movie?
HUNTING KNIFE.name: HUNTING KNIFE

KOMMANDO.description:
The cool guy's blade.
The M48 Kommando is too radical to be used by any current military force, banned across many army competitive scenes for being too overpowerful.
If you own one, you (don't) own the world.
KOMMANDO.name: KOMMANDO

TACTICAL SPATULA.description: This spatula can open bottles, help you fry eggs, and dice watermelons in a single swing. Slightly faster swing time.
TACTICAL SPATULA.name: TACTICAL SPATULA

BOTTLE.description: Dangerous seasonal brew made by Grandma (TM), held within a reused glass bottle. Don't question why the contents are glowing, instead ask how in the world you keep breaking the bottle, and how you keep getting new ones.
BOTTLE.name: BOTTLE

TASER.description:
Uniquely designed stun gun that delivers shocks by mashing the button! Especially effective against lawyers.
Model by Poodros.
TASER.name: TASER

ARM CANNON.description:
Darn, looks like you forgot the long beam upgrade...
An advanceed weapon from an unknown time said to be used by the greatest space hunter in the galaxy...
Model by Vic.
ARM CANNON.name: ARM CANNON

MAGLITE CLUB.description:
A sturdy flashlight made to withstand a hardy beating, and dish beatings back out too. Great for when you can't see what's right in front of you. Average overall.
Halloween 2020 Melee made by Vic.
MAGLITE CLUB.name: MAGLITE CLUB

CRICKET BAT.description: A regulation-size cricket bat, used for the sport of cricket. It's well worn, so it won't crack on you, even while you're cracking the skulls of your enemies. Functionally identical to the Crowbar.
CRICKET BAT.name: CRICKET BAT

CANDY CANE.description: Absurdly sized holiday treat in StyLiS flavor! Use it to bring cheer to the scrooges in the warzone. Short range but very fast to swing!
CANDY CANE.name: CANDY CANE

BARE FISTS.description:
Who needs weapons when YOU are the weapon?
Lay the smack down on your foes with a flurry of punches. You'll also run pretty fast on your feet too!
Don't expect to be too effective in combat...
Cannot unlock skins for this weapon.
BARE FISTS.name: BARE FISTS

FLAME OF OLYMPIA.description:
A torch whose fire never seems to stop burning with the emotions of competition and sportsmanship shown throughout the events it will kick off. It is truly a monumental event for you to even be holding this.
Model by Shelby.
FLAME OF OLYMPIA.name: FLAME OF OLYMPIA

NIGHTSTICK.description:
A traditional club carried by police officers and private security forces alike. Fast swing speed with middling damage.
Welcome to my DEATH MACHINE, interloper!
Model by Shay.
NIGHTSTICK.name: NIGHTSTICK

PACIFIC FM.description:
Tune: Cold Front
A skywave radio customized to pick up a secure frequency on the air waves. Produced in a far off east factory...
Model by Victor.
PACIFIC FM.name: PACIFIC FM

SCL-S2: ID.description:
Melee for the winners of the second season of the StyLiS Competitive League.
Using the power of fire, launch a magic fireball towards your foes!
Congratulations to Icarus Dash!
SCL-S2: ID.name: SCL-S2: ID

STICK GRENADE.description: A deactivated explosive. Still useful for clobbering your enemies over the head. Quick swing time with lower damage.
STICK GRENADE.name: STICK GRENADE

KEYBOARD.description: You know that one guy? The guy that always seems to land a headshot every shot. The one who taunts after every kill. The keyboard warrior in you needs this instrument to enact your revenge.
KEYBOARD.name: KEYBOARD

TOY GUN.description: A toy noisemaker/dart-shooter revolver made to entertain children. Generally rounded out stats overall.
TOY GUN.name: TOY GUN

UCHIWA.description:
A war fan of ancient design. Great for bonkin' the heads of your enemies! Soldiers who use this often feel the need to scream Tenno Heika.
Model by Shelby.
UCHIWA.name: UCHIWA

THE COUNTDOWN.description: Thank you for supporting Phantom Forces and StyLiS Studios up to the year 2023!
THE COUNTDOWN.name: THE COUNTDOWN

MJOLNIR.description: You, soldier of fortune, happened upon a power beyond your mortal understanding. You take the weapon, hold it the boundless skies and know that you are worthy.
MJOLNIR.name: MJOLNIR

ASP BATON.description: A collapsible baton intended for police use. Quick swing and movement speed with poor range.
ASP BATON.name: ASP BATON

STARLIS FUNPOST.description: A wand of magical origin, imbued with the ancient magic of times gone by. It is powered by DEAD MEMES!
STARLIS FUNPOST.name: STARLIS FUNPOST

TRENCH MACE.description: A relic from the trenches of World War I. Quick swing speed with higher than average damage.
TRENCH MACE.name: TRENCH MACE

CLONKER.description:
A giant wooden sword toy being repurposed into the ultimate holiday bonker! Good speed, good reach, average damage.
Holiday 2020 melee made by Makosushi.
CLONKER.name: CLONKER

BRASS KNUCKLE.description: A small weapon intended to be held in a clenched fist to improve punching force. Very short range with incredibly fast swing speeds.
BRASS KNUCKLE.name: BRASS KNUCKLE

BLOXY.description: A staff commemorating the milestones Phantom Forces has achieved, Thank you for being a part of it's history.
BLOXY.name: BLOXY

FUMELEE.description: S-stylis.. please dont turn me into marketable plushies.. STYLIS!!
FUMELEE.name: FUMELEE

CROWBAR.description:
A long pry bar, useful for getting into crates that are nailed down. It's also good for dealing with dangerous aliens. Quick swing time with moderate damage.
Model by Shay.
CROWBAR.name: CROWBAR

FIXER.description:
A simple tool for a simple job, ain't gonna complicate things.
Model by Darkman_Bree.
FIXER.name: FIXER

SPARKLER.description: Fourth of July; The town really outdid itself this year. I feel like I'm watching every dollar I paid in property tax explode in my face.
SPARKLER.name: SPARKLER

SLEIGH BELLS.description: JINGLE! JINGLE! JINGLE! JINGLE! JINGLE! JINGLE! JINGLE! JINGLE! JINGLE!
SLEIGH BELLS.name: SLEIGH BELLS

SLAY BELLS.description: Jingle the jangle of any one who opposes you. Very short range with incredibly fast swing speeds.
SLAY BELLS.name: SLAY BELLS

TANZANITE PICK.description: A truly retro pickaxe crafted from jewels. Great for finding rare ores in the wild. Halloween 2020 Melee.
TANZANITE PICK.name: TANZANITE PICK

BRICK.description:
The perfect tool for liberation, torn directly from a wall of stone.

Model submitted by Vic
BRICK.name: BRICK

GOLDEN PAN.description: Like the Frying Pan, but way cooler. 😎
GOLDEN PAN.name: GOLDEN PAN

FRYING PAN.description:
This steel frying pan is great for cooking with. Few things are scarier than a demolition man holding one of these things charging at you. Higher damage with a slower swing.
PWONG!
FRYING PAN.name: FRYING PAN

SAIGA-12U.description: A Saiga 12 without a stock and a very short barrel. Has a high rate of fire with a very wide spread and a small magazine.
SAIGA-12U.name: SAIGA-12U

SASS 308.description: A single shot pistol based on the M1911 developed in the 1980s. Chambered in the .308 Winchester cartridge among many other offerings.
SASS 308.name: SASS 308

SERBU SHOTGUN.description: An ultra-short pump action shotgun based on the Model 870. Small capacity with wide spread.
SERBU SHOTGUN.name: SERBU SHOTGUN

SAWED OFF.description: An ultra-short double-barreled shotgun. Capable of firing both barrels at once. Very wide spread.
SAWED OFF.name: SAWED OFF

M79 THUMPER.description: A single-shot break-action grenade launcher that is loaded with a 10-round hornet's nest of .22 long rifle and tons of other ammo using proper shells or adapters. First appeared during the Kimlan War, it earned many nicknames by the soldiers.
M79 THUMPER.name: M79 THUMPER

E GUN.description:
A second one? Why does this need to exist?
Another E-Gun, this ones just named the COILGUN. This one favours being used for self defence being in your secondary slot with marginally similar performance to its primary counterpart.
E GUN.name: E GUN

SFG 50.description:
A BFG 50 with the barrel hacked off. As should be expected from this 'modification', it hits hard, but is highly inaccurate at range.

Model submitted by Rialag.
SFG 50.name: SFG 50

STAKEOUT.description:
One of the more iconic variations of the Model 37, this shorter version has seen use by detectives, Black Ops units, and space marines. Greater CQC performance compared to the full size counterpart, and bonus points for the cool factor. "They have used you like they have used me. You must decide what you think is worth fighting for." 

Model submitted by Vic!
STAKEOUT.name: STAKEOUT

attachmentModifiers.info:
A longer magazine for tube-shotguns!
Increases magazine capacity with lower overall handling.
Also comes with a traditional pump, reducing your fire rate!

THUNDER.description:
A unique Grand Federation pistol chambered in .50 BMG. Due to its caliber, features very high damage with great penetration capabilities and low reserve ammo, however, suffers from poor velocity and heavy inverted recoil due to its design. Free wrist pain is on the house!

Model submitted by Vic.
THUNDER.name: THUNDER

OBREZ.description: A shortened Mosin Nagant intended for use by revolutionaries and insurgents. Inaccurate, but instantly kills with headshots.
OBREZ.name: OBREZ

LUTY.description:
A decently made but still crude submachine gun built in the back of the gun store as a hobby.
Poor handling, not super great.
Probably should grab whatever gun you find on the next guy.

Model submitted by Vic.
LUTY.name: LUTY

HONEY BADGER.description:
A compact Grand Federation PDW based on the AR-15 platform firing the 300 Blackout round. Moderate recoil with average performance all around.

Model submitted by Rialag & Vic.
HONEY BADGER.name: HONEY BADGER

FIVE-0.description: A highly customized subcompact PDW chambered in .50 GI built off of the AR-9 platform. Extremely high damage up close at the cost of extreme recoil and low magazine capacity.
FIVE-0.name: FIVE-0

MAX31.description:
A Grand Federation upgrade kit for the MAC-11 designed to use the 9mm Suomi KP/31's Magazines. Used as a way for the everyman to have a cheaper modern Submachine gun with existing parts.

Model submitted by Vic.
MAX31.name: MAX31

P90.description:
The P90, or Project 90, was an attempt to fulfill a desire for a standardized PDW. Though this never happened, the P90 has enjoyed constant media attention in part because of its unique design and its 5.7mm cartridge. With good damage, decently low recoil, and a very high RPM, the P90 is a solid choice for every situation.
It's O'Neill, with TWO L's!
P90.name: P90

TOMMY GUN.description:
One of the most important guns of World War II, the Thompson holds its origin in prototypes that just missed The Great War. Its great weight makes for poor mobility, but for reasonable if not bouncy recoil with great damage up close. Has a variety of magazine options.
Make him an offer he can't refuse.
TOMMY GUN.name: TOMMY GUN

BWC9.description: A sub-compact personal defense weapon with the ability to fold down for discrete storage. Based on the M17, it features fully automatic fire, great mobility, and pistol-class handling. Unfortunately, the gun's auto-sear was installed poorly and does not allow you to stop until the magazine is fully emptied. Oops!
BWC9.name: BWC9

attachmentModifiers.info: I mean... I guess? If you really want to. But why though?

X95 SMG.description: The X95 SMG is a 9x19mm conversion of the Tavor X95. Designed to ease the training requirements for soldiers, it features many of the modern features that assault rifles do whilst retaining SMG characteristics. The X95 SMG is good for nearly all ranges, with middling RPM and recoil.
X95 SMG.name: X95 SMG

G36C.description: An extremely short subcarbine variant of the Eisenmark STG-91 assault rifle. Being incredibly short, it can be used by armored vehicle crews. Trades some close range performance for better long range performance.
G36C.name: G36C

PP-19 BIZON.description:
The PP-19 Bizon is a 9mm submachine gun developed in the mid-1990s by Izhmash made famous by its huge, cylindrical magazine. The Bizon is capable of decent damage up-close, but falls off considerably at range despite its huge magazine. It also comes in both 9x19mm and 9x18mm from the factory.
Kept ya' waiting, huh?
PP-19 BIZON.name: PP-19 BIZON

UZI.description: The Uzi is an Eretz-Kedem submachine gun favored by the EKF throughout the Cold War. Known for its relative simplicity and great reliability, The Uzi packs a heavy punch for its 9x19 ammo, but suffers with bouncy recoil, somewhat reduced range performance, and poor mobility thanks to its relatively great weight.
UZI.name: UZI

COLT MARS.description: A prototype PDW designed in 1997 based on the AR-15 platform firing the unique 5.56x30 Mini Assault Rifle System (MARS) cartridge. Higher RPM and penetration with lower damage, coupled with high multipliers.
COLT MARS.name: COLT MARS

GOLDEN TOMMY GUN.description: SAY HELLO TO MY LITTLE FRIEND.
GOLDEN TOMMY GUN.name: GOLDEN TOMMY GUN

FAL PARA SHORTY.description: A heavily customized FAL 50.63, and as such has battle rifle characteristics. Has an incredibly short barrel, leading to poor recoil management and equally poor range.
FAL PARA SHORTY.name: FAL PARA SHORTY

SCAR PDW.description:
A carbine variant of the MK16 SOCOM. Slow rate of fire, but has very strong close range performance and snappy weapon handling.

Model submitted by Mysterious Modeler X.
SCAR PDW.name: SCAR PDW

MP5.description: Famous for its police and near-ubiquitous media usage, the SMX-9 is an Eisenmarkian submachine gun favored for its size. Though specializing in very little, the SMX-9 is a jack of all trades with good damage, good recoil, good RPM, and good handling.
MP5.name: MP5

HK416C.description:
A PDW variant of the Eisenmarkian M416, rumoured to have been made specifically for Soveran Air Service for their subcompact carbine needs.
Has good handling with mobility and optimal damage counteracted by slower fire rate and smaller initial magazine capacity.
''This might actually be the world's most boring job.''

Model submitted by Rialag.
HK416C.name: HK416C

KRINKOV.description: A extra short Kalashnikov weapon firing the 5.45x39mm cartridge. Fires much faster than the standard Kalashnikov automatic, and reloads at lightning fast speeds. It is also considered a Krinkov, a nickname given to extra short barreled AK's in the Grand Federation market.
KRINKOV.name: KRINKOV

L2A3.description: The L2A3, otherwise known as the Sterling, is a PDW that was intended to replace the aging Sten gun in Soveran service. Slower RPM for its class and a pistol cartridge mean the SMG features good recoil and good up close damage.
L2A3.name: L2A3

MP40.description: The progenitor to a variety of modern SMGs, the MP40 is a famous, vintage Great War Eisenmarkian submachine gun. Its relatively slow RPM and smaller cartridge lends itself to incredibly controllable recoil and decent ranged performance.
MP40.name: MP40

MP5SD.description: The SMX-9SD is a specialized, integrally suppressed version of the SMX-9. Desired for its great suppressor and quiet operation, the SMX-9SD boasts impressive point-blank damage for a 9x19mm SMG with low recoil, and poor ranged performance.
MP5SD.name: MP5SD

MP5/10.description: The SMX-9/10 was a response to a desire from police forces to utilize a cartridge larger than the SMX-9's regular 9x19mm. Chambered in 10mm Auto, the SMX-9/10 has fantastic damage point-blank and impressive damage range retention. It suffers from poor recoil as a result of its retooling into 10mm.
MP5/10.name: MP5/10

FAMAS COMMANDO.description:
A rare short-barrelled version of the Lysorian FAMAS G2 intended for international exports but saw no international interest.
Only a few prototypes exist of this gun and how it performs is largely unknown.
It has the fastest fire rate but struggles with recoil and quick damage drop off.
Burst fire reduces recoil by 20% and increases RPM by 100!

Model submitted by Mysterious Modeler X.
FAMAS COMMANDO.name: FAMAS COMMANDO

MP5K.description: The SMX-9K is a subcompact, lightweight version of the SMX-9 that looks straight out of a spy movie. Aided by its mobility, it packs a real punch up close and has the low recoil necessary for a decent range.
MP5K.name: MP5K

RAMA 1130.description: The RAMA 1130 is a prototypical, fully automatic conversion of the Makarov by the Zarovian Academy of Rocket and Artillery Sciences (RAMA). Never leaving the prototype stage, the RAMA is a bullet-hose featuring high RPM and high magazine capacity.
RAMA 1130.name: RAMA 1130

IA2 SMG.description:
A prototype SMG based off of the Selvazian IA2 platform for use with law-enforcement, designed as a potential replacement for the IMBEL MT-40.

Possesses a relatively modest rate of fire with above-average damage and snappy handling.
IA2 SMG.name: IA2 SMG

MP7.description:
The X46A2 was a response to the a new push to develop more compact cartridges. With a higher-than-average penetration for its class, low recoil, blazingly fast RPM, and impressive ergonomics, the X46A2 is a great all-arounder in nearly every situation.
Pick up that can.

Model submitted by Rialag.
MP7.name: MP7

COLT SMG 635.description:
A compact M16A1-derived SMG chambered in 9x19mm. Designed for discreet operations and close-quarters engagements, it features an incredibly high rate of fire and relatively impressive handling.

Why did the energy department need one of these again?
COLT SMG 635.name: COLT SMG 635

attachmentModifiers.info: A heavy hydralic buffer that slows down the rate of fire of the M635 to a slightly more controllable level, providing better recoil control.

MP10.description: Largely regarded as a failure, the SMX-10 was a private company's attempt to modernize the SMX-9 with integrated rails and a flashlight-holding foregrip. The SMX-10 maintains greater damage retention over range, but sacrifices close range performance.
MP10.name: MP10

AUG A3 PARA.description:
A paratrooper model of the UAR A3, chambered in 9mm. Slightly reduced magazine size compared to most other PDWs, but features impressive recoil control.

Model submitted by Rialag.
AUG A3 PARA.name: AUG A3 PARA

MAC10.description:
A Grand Federation PDW that fires .45 ACP at a blisteringly high rate of fire. Very lightweight. Poor accuracy while aimed, with stable hip-fire characteristics.

Remodel submitted by Vic.
MAC10.name: MAC10

UMP45.description:
Designed as a replacement to the SMX-9, the PDX-45 is a heavy-hitting, low recoil-oriented platform that lends itself to consistently good performance. With great damage, great mobility, and decent recoil, the PDX-45 is a good choice for all purposes.

Model submitted by Rialag.
UMP45.name: UMP45

I MP-9.description:
An extremely simple Nordhelm designed submachine gun, intended for military and police applications.
