Without any government interest, the gun was later redesigned and simplified for the civilian market into what is known as the KG-99 and TEC-9 today. Very few examples of the MP-9 were ever made, with estimates at around 25 or even fewer. High rate of fire with controllable recoil and excellent handling, but somewhat poor damage.

Model submitted by Vic.
I MP-9.name: I MP-9

M3A1.description:
The M3A1, affectionately known as the Grease Gun as a result of its unique shape, is an iconic World War II SMG. Renowned for being made cheaply, its low-RPM, low-recoil, but very high damage nevertheless make it an impressive option.

Model submitted by Vic.
M3A1.name: M3A1

K7.description:
A Seongho submachine gun stemming from the K1A rifle. It has fast handling, a high firerate and is very stable, however this stability is a tradeoff for its poor range performance...
What do you mean you want to use muzzle devices on it?
K7.name: K7

PPSH-41.description: Known affectionately as Papasha by Zarovian troops during World War II, the PPSH-41 features an extremely large magazine for its size. Its great weight and 7.62x25mm Tokarev cartridge means poor mobility and middling recoil, but its 1250 RPM means you'll never be wanting for more ammunition. Until you run out, at least.
PPSH-41.name: PPSH-41

KRISS VECTOR.description: Powered by its unique downward inertial block recoil system, the Vector is known for its impressively low recoil despite its extremely high rate of fire and its larger-than-most pistol cartridge. Its recoil system lends itself to incredible up-close performance, but its awkward pattern and .45ACP ammo type mean it suffers at range.
KRISS VECTOR.name: KRISS VECTOR

DEAGLE 44.description: A modern version of the iconic Eretz-Kedem pistol design. This specific model has been lightened as well as upgraded with dual Picatinny rails and a much needed muzzle brake. Very high damage with the capacity to instantly kill to the head up close, with rough recoil.
DEAGLE 44.name: DEAGLE 44

ALIEN.description: A unique and innovative Korvan pistol. Unlike other pistols, the Alien is a competition pistol that has been designed to have reduced muzzle flip and does not follow a typical pistols design with sights not reciprocating with the slide.
ALIEN.name: ALIEN

GYROJET MARK I.description: A failed 'Pistol' from the 1960's produced by MBA. Due to how the rockets in this weapon functions. The damage model is reversed, doing more damage across longer ranges. The system quite literally failed for being light years ahead of its time.
GYROJET MARK I.name: GYROJET MARK I

M7644.description:
HORROR.
A modified version of the AF-2011A1 pistol, this one has FOUR barrels instead of two!
M7644.name: M7644

GLOCK 1.description: A REALLY small pistol, you may as well throw it away instead of reloading it.
GLOCK 1.name: GLOCK 1

M45A1.description: A modern Grand Federation pistol with many custom parts. High damage, medium capacity, strong recoil.
M45A1.name: M45A1

HARDBALLER.description: Strong ranged performance at the cost of somewhat high recoil - It may not be a phased plasma rifle in the 40-watt range, but this pistol still packs quite a lot of punch with every shot.
HARDBALLER.name: HARDBALLER

M1911.description: A classic Grand Federation pistol brought into the modern age. Very high damage up close, with poor velocity and small magazine size.
M1911.name: M1911

GLOCK 23.description: A .40 S&W G-Series pistol. Featuring characteristics similar to its original 9x19mm variant, with a swift reload alongside it.
GLOCK 23.name: GLOCK 23

FIVE SEVEN.description: A modern Belvaunian pistol firing a unique caliber. Poor close-in performance, with great ranged performance, high velocity, large magazine, wall penetration, and deep reserves.
FIVE SEVEN.name: FIVE SEVEN

AM III.description: A Grand Federation hand cannon brought to you by AMT. Loading the .30 Carbine cartridge and featuring impressive range potential, despite this it kicks incredibly high.
AM III.name: AM III

MAKAROV PM.description:
A small Novaruss era pistol with iconic design that still sees service even in the modern age.
Two alternate aim modes. Both allow you to fire faster than regular but at the cost of accuracy.
MAKAROV PM.name: MAKAROV PM

M9.description: A 9mm Roma Invicta pistol. One of the first 'wonder nines'. High capacity with deep reserves, light recoil, and high velocity.
M9.name: M9

GB-22.description: A homemade pistol whose original design derives from Serbu. This version is larger than the original, and can accept multiple different calibers. Always kills to the head.
GB-22.name: GB-22

GLOCK 40.description: A G-series pistol chambered in the 10mm Auto round. Compared to the other G-series guns, it trades a bit of accuracy and close range performance for more power at longer ranges.
GLOCK 40.name: GLOCK 40

GLOCK 21.description: A G-Series pistol which chambers .45 ACP. This pistol features great close range damage and snappy recoil, however your performance will dwindle in range compared to other pistols.
GLOCK 21.name: GLOCK 21

BOXY BUSTER.description:
A toy gun that shoots foam darts?
Why would you bring a toy gun to an actual gun fight?
BOXY BUSTER.name: BOXY BUSTER

IZHEVSK PB.description: A Novaruss era integrally suppressed variant of the Makarov PM made by the Izhevsk mechanical plant. Doesn't fire too fast, but can instantly kill with a headshot in short ranges.
IZHEVSK PB.name: IZHEVSK PB

GSH-18.description:
A 9mm Zarovian pistol designed in the 1990s for the Zarovian police and armed forces. It fires 7N31 +P+ ammunition, which gives it much higher penetration and recoil than other pistols of the same caliber.

Model submitted by Rialag
GSH-18.name: GSH-18

GLOCK 17.description: A 9mm Alpenstahlan pistol renowned for its simplicity and ruggedness. Compared to the M9, it has a higher capacity, but less muzzle velocity.
GLOCK 17.name: GLOCK 17

ZIP 22.description:
A modern Grand Federation 'pistol' with questionable quality. Abysmal damage, but with deep reserves and a high headshot multiplier.
A weapon so bad it killed a million dollar company.
ZIP 22.name: ZIP 22

GI M1.description: An M1911 modified to chamber .50GI - a powerful ammunition that packs a lot of punch up close, but also comes with reduced accuracy and performance at range.
GI M1.name: GI M1

GSP.description: A single-action, precision targetshooting pistol made in Eisenmark. It was introduced on the world market in 1968 and was chambered for .22 Long Rifle.
GSP.name: GSP

GRIZZLY.description: A high-caliber pistol chambered in the .50 Action Express cartridge. While the recoil leaves something to be desired, the extremely powerful damage profile of the gun will have you saying 'haha, bear gun go boom'.
GRIZZLY.name: GRIZZLY

DEAGLE 50.description:
A gas-operated semi-automatic handgun chambered in .50 Action Express. The bulky design and large caliber make the gun highly unwieldy compared to other pistols, but with nearly unmatched stopping power up close.

High damage and high recoil with mediocre reserve ammo and handling.
DEAGLE 50.name: DEAGLE 50

M2011.description: A race gun variant of the M1911 chambered in 9x19mm with a large double-stack magazine. While the damage up front is poor compared to other pistols, it packs a very high headshot multiplier and the accuracy to make use of it.
M2011.name: M2011

M3822.description: A double barrel design based off the M1911. Features two of... well, everything! Features great damage in close range as you are firing two rounds at once but suffers range performance due to recoil and a slow reload.
M3822.name: M3822

GOLDEN GUN.description:
He has a powerful weapon. He charges a million a shot. An assassin that's second to none. The Man with the Golden Gun.

Model by Duo
GOLDEN GUN.name: GOLDEN GUN

GLOCK 50.description: A Grand Federation modification to an Alpenstahlan Classic. Reduced magazine capacity compared to the others, but has more stopping power. Has more than enough power to go through fruits, vegetables, water jugs, and whatever else you have at your range.
GLOCK 50.name: GLOCK 50

U416/22.description:
An Eisenmark imported pistol variant of the M416 for the Grand Federation civilian market. Very cheap and affordable, shoots 22lr and is a perfect trainer tool for beginners.

Model submitted by Rialag.
U416/22.name: U416/22

KG-99.description:
A Nordhelm semi-automatic pistol with an incredibly generous rate of fire, large magazine, and good accuracy. Lacks stopping power especially at range when compared to other pistols.
Sister to the Tec-9.

Model submitted by Vic.
KG-99.name: KG-99

M17.description: A modern Helzevia-Grand Federation Handgun. A service pistol fit for the modern age of Grand Federation foreign interests. Built with focus on ergonomics and modularity, this variant of the P320 sports lightweight construction, stable recoil and a generous magazine capacity. Get dirty and the world stays clean. That's the mission.
M17.name: M17

REDHAWK 44.description: A Grand Federation revolver designed to chamber the heaviest .44 Magnum loads, using a novel cylinder triple-lock mechanism not found on any other modern revolver design. The RH-44 is otherwise a relatively simple revolver. Possesses above average performance at range compared to other similar revolvers.
REDHAWK 44.name: REDHAWK 44

RSH-12.description:
A Zarovian assault revolver chambered in 12.7x55mm STs-130. Intended for use with special forces and elite police units in extreme close-quarters environments where a larger rifle would be impractical while still packing a similar punch. 

Unlike most revolvers, the RSh-12 has a sealed cylinder system which allows for the use of suppressors. Extremely high damage and recoil with relatively lackluster muzzle velocity.

Model submitted by ILLAXIS.
RSH-12.name: RSH-12

GOLDEN REDHAWK 45.description:
Saddle up partner, you're in for a ride...
A single-action revolver in a pristine golden finish. Chambered in .45 Long Colt, hits hard but is slow to cycle the cylinder.
GOLDEN REDHAWK 45.name: GOLDEN REDHAWK 45

MP412 REX.description: A break-open revolver prototype from Zarovia intended for export. High close-in damage and headshot multiplier with low ranged damage and a fast rate of fire.
MP412 REX.name: MP412 REX

attachmentModifiers.info: Yee-Haw! Get yourself a horse-rider's barrel and start shootin'! Increased muzzle velocity means you can down that honcho on the far side of the town before he can get you!
Less is more when it comes to being snubby. Usually reserved for the Noir side of things, but it will certainly help when your stakeout goes south. Significantly reduced muzzle velocity.

1858 NEW ARMY.description: A vintage Grand Federation ball-and-cap revolver with black powder rounds, fires in single-action with a slow rate of fire, excellent ranged performance, and the ability to fan-fire at a high speed.
1858 NEW ARMY.name: 1858 NEW ARMY

MATEBA 6.description:
A recoil-operated semi-automatic revolver with an unusual inverted cylinder and barrel arrangement which significantly reduces the gun's muzzle flip.

Possesses low damage for a revolver, but makes up for it with a high rate of fire with low recoil and a relatively speedy reload speed.
MATEBA 6.name: MATEBA 6

JUDGE.description: A compact revolver firing .410 bore shotshells. High per-pellet damage with moderate spread and fast fire rate.
JUDGE.name: JUDGE

EXECUTIONER.description: A full-size Selvazian revolver, loaded with .454 Casull for incredible stopping power. Massive damage up close with a high headshot multiplier, with harsh recoil and slow recovery.
EXECUTIONER.name: EXECUTIONER

E SHOTGUN.description: A weapon made purely for self defence, why you brought it here I don't know. Spits out five flat metal discs at a blisteringly high firerate without any smoke and very little felt recoil, doing low amounts of damage per disc, but is devastating when hit in the right places.
E SHOTGUN.name: E SHOTGUN

KSG 12.description: A high-capacity pump-action bullpup Grand Federation shotgun, with dual 7-round tubes. Wide spread.
KSG 12.name: KSG 12

KS-23M.description: A Zarovian shotgun built using 23mm aircraft gun barrels. This makes it the largest-bore shotgun in use, but it only fits 3 rounds in the tube. High damage, slow firerate, extremely tight spread.
KS-23M.name: KS-23M

ROPOD SHOTTY.description:
Lookin' real sussy right now man... REAL sussy...
Oversized, weaponised charging case for expensive wireless headphones. Perfect for catching a body.
ROPOD SHOTTY.name: ROPOD SHOTTY

DT11 PRO.description:
One Hit, One Shot, One Victory.
A sporting shotgun with its origins from the DT10 competition shotgun. It is very accurate boasting very tight pellet grouping. Uses custom #1 buckshot loads dealing very low damage with a long range preference.
DT11 PRO.name: DT11 PRO

GOLDEN SHORTY.description: Golden short barrel shotgun equipped with an overfolder stock.
GOLDEN SHORTY.name: GOLDEN SHORTY

attachmentModifiers.info: Swap your shorty's regular foregrip with a more traditional pump, decreases spread in exchange for a slower fire rate!

DBV12.description:
A smoothbore shotgun based off of the AK-12 pre-production variant, chambered for 12g shotgun shells. Unlike most of the other pre-production AK-12 variants, this one was officially announced in 2013 but never reached production. It was designed for the civilian sporting market.

Good rate of fire and damage, but somewhat high spread.

Model submitted by Rialag
DBV12.name: DBV12

SCX-12.description:
An Ankaran semi-automatic shotgun chambered for 12g shells that bears a curious resemblance to a certain other gun...
Above average rate of fire with relatively high damage at range, but below average spread and close-range damage.

Model submitted by Mysterious Modeler X.
SCX-12.name: SCX-12

AA-12.description: An iconic Grand Federation shotgun produced exclusively in fully automatic. It has one of the fastest fire rates, and can accept a 20 round drum magazine. Very low damage with very wide spread.
AA-12.name: AA-12

SPAS-12.description: An iconic Roma Invicta gas-actuated combat shotgun with a 7 round tube magazine. Features a fast fire rate and tight spread with high damage.
SPAS-12.name: SPAS-12

COBRAY TERMINATOR.description:
A slam-firing single feed shotgun designed as cheap as possible while still being safe to handle.
Poor recoil but has access to some more exotic shotshells.
Some may describe it as the worst shotgun ever made!

Model submitted by Vic.
COBRAY TERMINATOR.name: COBRAY TERMINATOR

USAS-12.description: A Seongho automatic shotgun. Featuring a tight group of pellets at a very low muzzle velocity, dealing low damage with an unmatched firerate and boasts a quick reload. Now where are those frag rounds...
USAS-12.name: USAS-12

SAIGA-12.description: A firearm made by Kalashnikov Concern that is primarily focused on the civilian market. It feeds from an 8 round box magazine and has a blisteringly fast fire rate, but a slow reload and wide spread.
SAIGA-12.name: SAIGA-12

STEVENS DB.description: A classic double-barrel shotgun with plenty of punch and an instanteous burst. It spells doom for whatever's in front of it.
STEVENS DB.name: STEVENS DB

ITHACA 37.description:
A classic Grand Federation shotgun once commonly used by police. Has seen use in multiple battlefields due to its slam-fire capabilities, and was used in jungle warfare due to the lack of a side-based ejection port. Nothing really beats a 12 gauge in close quarters.

Model submitted by Vic!
ITHACA 37.name: ITHACA 37

attachmentModifiers.info: M37 combat stock

REMINGTON 870.description: A traditional pump-action shotgun with a 7-round tube and polymer furniture. Tight spread.
REMINGTON 870.name: REMINGTON 870

TRG-42.description: A Suomira bolt-action rifle. Higher-than-average velocity with a fast reload, but slow bolt chambering action.
TRG-42.name: TRG-42

REMINGTON 700.description: A classic Grand Federation bolt-action sniper with a Magpul polymer frame. Middle-of-the-road in all respects.
REMINGTON 700.name: REMINGTON 700

WA2000.description:
A semi-automatic bullpup Eisenmarkian sniper rifle intended for law enforcement as a counter-terrorist weapon. Very few were made, making it highly sought after. Fast fire rate, moderate damage, poor recoil control.
Section 26, paragraph 5 - need to know. I'm sure you understand.

Remodeled by Mysterious Modeler X.
WA2000.name: WA2000

BFG 50.description:
A Grand Federation anti-materiel rifle. Hits like a truck, but only chambers a single round, necessitating frequent reloads.

Model submitted by Rialag.
BFG 50.name: BFG 50

attachmentModifiers.info: Lightened stock with a simplified buttstock and pistol grip.

HECATE II.description: A magazine-fed .50 BMG rifle with relatively middling stats for the caliber. What it lacks in the punch or rate of fire of other .50 BMG snipers, it makes up for in consistency.
HECATE II.name: HECATE II

AWS.description: A suppressed version of the L115A3 firing a smaller cartridge. Suffers from reduced velocity, but feeds from a 10 round magazine, with middling firerate.
AWS.name: AWS

CS/LR-4A.description:
The CS/LR-4A is a high precision sniper utilizing a specially designed CS/DFL3 7.62x51mm cartridge, though it can accept standard .308 ammunition.

The gun was designed as a replacement for the JS 7.62mm and is in used with Jinhanian police detachments.

Community submitted model.
CS/LR-4A.name: CS/LR-4A

FT300.description:
A Helzevian competition rifle developed by Grünig & Elmiger.
This rifle, going by the moniker of the 'Free Rifle'. This rifle sees use not in combat, but in shooting events in competitions. Featuring a lot of unique traits and ammo types keeping the most seasoned shooter entertained.
How will you use it?
FT300.name: FT300

K14.description:
A Seongho bolt-action rifle developed as its standard sniper rifle.

Compared to other rifles, the K14 has shorter torso killing potential, but this is made up for with its 60-degree bolt handle. Allowing for swift action of the bolt with its nimble nature. Swift aim in speed and aim walkspeed but slower when walking normally and unaiming.
K14.name: K14

INTERVENTION.description: A Grand Federation bolt-action sniper rifle famed for its precision and power. Slow fire rate, large magazine size.
INTERVENTION.name: INTERVENTION

L115A3.description: A Soveran bolt-action sniper rifle with a high fire rate chambered in the powerful .338 Lapua Magnum cartridge that can travel at really fast speed and deal a lot of damage. Even being capable of one shotting an enemy to the limb at close range! The heavy weight and slow action does however plague this weapon.
L115A3.name: L115A3

DSR-50.description:
An Eisenmark bullpup bolt-action .50 BMG rifle upscaled from the DSR-1.
Features a hydraulic recoil buffer in the stock and a blast compensator style muzzle device, a combination of sound suppression and a muzzle brake.
Offers decent fast cycling speed for an AMR with very high damage, bullet speed and heavy weight and a small magazine that holds only 3 rounds.

Model Submitted by Mysterious Modeler X.
DSR-50.name: DSR-50

BALLISTA.description:
A modular Belvaunian bolt-action sniper rifle with access to multiple calibers.
Combines very high power, high bullet speed, penetration and magazine capacity for a slow fire rate, reload time and heavy weight!
Uses .338 Lapua Magnum by default but can be easily changed to another to meet your playstyle!

Model submitted by Rialag.
BALLISTA.name: BALLISTA

TIMBERWOLF.description:
A Cascadian sniper rifle in .338 Lapua Magnum with an atypical helical fluting to its barrel. Performs somewhat poorly at close range, but possesses incredibly high mid-to-long range performance.

Model submitted by Rialag
TIMBERWOLF.name: TIMBERWOLF

RAILGUN.description: The iconic electrical rifle from the moon is now in your hands! Incredibly fast bullet velocity, with an accompanying slow reload.
RAILGUN.name: RAILGUN

NTW-20.description:
A Sudenkaap anti-materiel rifle that is used against anything from equipment to against personnel. A very heavy rifle that has the power to match with its 20x82mm ammunition.
However, you must be crouching, prone or be near a valid spot, such as a window or a ledge to rest your bipod to take aim. But this can be remedied with shorter barrels.
NTW-20.name: NTW-20

MOSIN NAGANT.description: A vintage Zarovian sniper rifle dating from the 1900s. 5-round internal magazine makes for quick reloading alongside a reasonably swift fire rate. Lightweight and accurate, this rifle is meant for headshotting only but otherwise still deals large body damage!
MOSIN NAGANT.name: MOSIN NAGANT

VKS.description:
The VKS, also sometimes called the VSSK, is a bullpup straight-pull bolt-action sniper rifle chambered for 12.7x55mm STS-130. The weapon uses an integrally mounted suppressor and is designed for situations requiring more penetration than is offered by the 9x39mm subsonic round from the VSS Vintorez sniper rifle. It has been in service since 2004 with Zarovian special forces.

Model submitted by Mysterious Modeler X
VKS.name: VKS

M1903.description: A Grand Federation bolt action rifle designed in 1903. The M1903 since its days from The Great War and the Second World War has seen use in the modern era as a competitive sporting rifle, collecters piece and as a military drill rifle.
M1903.name: M1903

DRAGUNOV SVDS.description: A paratrooper version of the SVD rifle, with a light frame and folding stock. Semi-automatic with 10 round magazine, but suffers from poor recoil recovery.
DRAGUNOV SVDS.name: DRAGUNOV SVDS

M107.description:
The M82A1 is one of the most prolific anti-materiel rifles ever produced. It is semi-automatic and magazine-fed, allowing it to put out rounds incredibly quickly for the caliber. The A1M variant includes numerous upgrades to the muzzle brake, a rear grip with a monopod socket, and improved accessory rails.

Extremely high damage with a high rate of fire, but cumbersome handling and recoil that is ill-suited for that firerate.

Big whoop, I'm using a Barrett .50 cal. I could kill a building.

Model submitted by Rialag
M107.name: M107

STEYR SCOUT.description:
A sniper rifle with a design focus on portability and practical accuracy at midrange rather than raw firepower and long-range performance.

Has extremely comfortable handling and a high rate of fire for a marksman weapon, but punishes missed headshots more than other similar weapons.
STEYR SCOUT.name: STEYR SCOUT

KEK-50.description: A custom Tec platform Anti-Materiel Rifle chambered in .50 BMG. Not only is it full auto, the recoil wants to rip it right from your hands! April Fools!
KEK-50.name: KEK-50

M110A1.description:
An Eisenmarkian Compact Semi Automatic Sniper System (CSASS) made for use by Grand Federation, developed from the M417 platform and bearing similarities with M28 GDMR.
It's able to instantly kill to the head at any range while still carrying a punch, though, slower velocity and rapid firing will make landing hits difficult at longer ranges.

Model submitted by Rialag.
M110A1.name: M110A1

attachmentModifiers.info:
A larger 20 round magazine!
Doubles your magazine capacity at the cost of handling, mobility and reload time!

COMP 1022.description:
A custom body kit for the R-10/22 rifle designed for competition shooting. Fires a specialty high-velocity ammunition.

Extremely low recoil and excellent handling, but extremely poor performance to the torso.

Model submitted by Vic
COMP 1022.name: COMP 1022

THE FIX.description:
A lightweight bolt-action sporting rifle chambered in the unusual 8.6 Blackout subsonic cartridge.

Extremely good handling with a somewhat unique damage profile to compensate for extremely low velocity.

Model submitted by Vic
THE FIX.name: THE FIX

CS/LR-3.description:
The CS/LR-3 is a bolt-action sniper chambered in 5.8x42mm DBU-141 which, paired with a free-floating barrel design, improves accuracy significantly compared to earlier snipers used by the People's Liberation Army.

High muzzle velocity and a fast bolting speed, but relatively low damage compared to other snipers.

Community submitted model.
CS/LR-3.name: CS/LR-3

ZIRCON TRIDENT.description: A truly retro spear crafted from jewels. Amazing for two dimensional hordes. Halloween 2020 Melee.
ZIRCON TRIDENT.name: ZIRCON TRIDENT

LONGSWORD.description: A traditional European longsword forged from the finest steel. Lower damage with a slightly slower swing time.
LONGSWORD.name: LONGSWORD

NORDIC WAR AXE.description: An ornamental war axe that's still incredibly lethal. Make sure it's the last sunset they'll see. Moderate range with moderate damage and slower swings.
NORDIC WAR AXE.name: NORDIC WAR AXE

ZERO CUTTER.description:
Summon a glass construct blade that cuts through robots as if they were merely air.
High-speed attacks that have combo potential!
Model by Shay.
ZERO CUTTER.name: ZERO CUTTER

REAPER.description: A vintage scythe, sharpened and ready to mow. When you hold it, your blood runs cold, but you're not entirely sure why. High damage with short range and slow swings.
REAPER.name: REAPER

NOOBSLAYER.description:
May the red light of holy judgement give mercy to those who dare oppose you.
Rip and tear through foes with sweeping attacks!
Halloween 2020 Melee made by Vic.
NOOBSLAYER.name: NOOBSLAYER

TRAINING BAYONET.description:
Unlocked with the MOSIN NAGANT.
Wooden training rifle outfitted with an original M1891 bayonet. Perfect for stabbin' fools!
Insane amount of reach.
Bayonet model by ILLAXIS.
TRAINING BAYONET.name: TRAINING BAYONET

ZWEIHANDER.description:
A sword truly made for war. Blade long enough to split the skys. Slow speed, high damage.
Model made by Makosushi and Tammy.
ZWEIHANDER.name: ZWEIHANDER

WORLD BUSTER.description: Foretold in legends one who wields the blade of world's end would rise and bring terror to the land. Functions similarly to the Long Sword.
WORLD BUSTER.name: WORLD BUSTER

NAGINATA.description: A pole weapon utilized by the ancient samurai, but most iconically by the female warriors called onna-bugeisha.
NAGINATA.name: NAGINATA

CHOSEN ONE.description:
Powerful beam-sword from a galaxy far, far away. It is an elegant weapon for a more civilized age.
High damage with a balanced moveset from all three styles of combat.
Model by Shay.
CHOSEN ONE.name: CHOSEN ONE

ICEMOURNE.description:
A blade forged from a frost giant, his hate for humanity glistens bright in the blade. Northern lights expel when the blade is swung. Good damage and range.
Made by Shaylan007.
ICEMOURNE.name: ICEMOURNE

FIRE AXE.description:
A chopping tool used by firefighters to save lives by clearing debris in their way. Also used by maniacs who become a dull boy...
Hippity hoppity I'm choppin' down your property!
FIRE AXE.name: FIRE AXE

HATTORI.description: A Tetsugawa katana favored by ronin, travelling samurai that serve no master. Long range with high damage and fast swings.
HATTORI.name: HATTORI

HARVESTER.description:
They say through the realm of unseen power there comes a dark scythe whose powerful blade can only be seen while swinging. That weapon now rests in your hands. Average swing speed and damage, but quick sprint speed for its size.
Designed by Vic.
HARVESTER.name: HARVESTER

BASEBALL BAT.description: A bat used for playing baseball, which just so happens to be useful for bonking people over the head. Fast swing time with very long range and lower damage.
BASEBALL BAT.name: BASEBALL BAT

HOCKEY STICK.description: The perfect tool to end the game of those that get in your way, but then apologize straight after. Fast swing.
HOCKEY STICK.name: HOCKEY STICK

SLEDGE HAMMER.description: A heavy, industrial grade sledge hammer. Very high damage and long range with slow swing speed.
SLEDGE HAMMER.name: SLEDGE HAMMER

SCL-S3: DRASTIC.description:
Melee for the winners of the third season of the StyLiS Competitive League.
Bearing a comically oversized kitchen utensil, bludgen your enemies with only a spoonful of pain! Congratulations to Drastic!
Model by Boxie.
SCL-S3: DRASTIC.name: SCL-S3: DRASTIC

ZIRCON SLAMSICKLE.description: A truly retro hammer and scythe combo crafted from jewels. The perfect tool for multiple situations. Halloween 2020 Melee.
ZIRCON SLAMSICKLE.name: ZIRCON SLAMSICKLE

SCL-S4: MALICIOUS INTENT.description:
Melee for the winners of the fourth season of the StyLiS Competitive League.
TBE.
SCL-S4: MALICIOUS INTENT.name: SCL-S4: MALICIOUS INTENT

STYLIS BRUSH.description: Brush often, floss, and beat them to an inch of their life.
STYLIS BRUSH.name: STYLIS BRUSH

STOPPER.description:
You'd have to be a crazed clown to use a stop sign as a melee weapon!
The most nimble of the 'heavy weight' weapons.
Model by Vic.
Spotting Easter Egg voiced by Zesty.
STOPPER.name: STOPPER

SCL-S1: GANG.description:
Trophy for winners of the first ever season of the StyLiS Competitive League.
Bludgeon your foes, or strike them down with the souls of your defeated enemies!
Congratulations to GANG!
SCL-S1: GANG.name: SCL-S1: GANG

BAN HAMMER.description:
A comically large gavel commemorating your time and work on staff.
From all of us at StyLiS Studios, thank you staff members for all that you do!
Model by Duo.
BAN HAMMER.name: BAN HAMMER

CURSED SHINAI.description: A large training sword primaly made of bamboo. It's cursed to house a foul Yokai that downed many foes with this very training sword. Stare at the sword long enough, and you will hear them...
CURSED SHINAI.name: CURSED SHINAI

BANJO.description:
If it hadn't been for Cotton-Eye Joe, I'd been married a long time ago.

Where did you come from, where did you go? Where did you come from, Cotton-Eye Joe?
BANJO.name: BANJO

WARHAMMER.description:
Forged by the blacksmiths of the middle east, this warhammer has been through countless battles. Treat it right, and it'll treat you right.
Holiday 2020 melee made by ILLAXIS.
WARHAMMER.name: WARHAMMER

MORNING STAR.description: The classic pointy star of war found throughout history now in the palms of your hands. Use your power without remorse, the crusade starts again!
MORNING STAR.name: MORNING STAR

VOID STAFF.description:
Void worm inspired melee, weaponize the power of a black hole into this inhuman staff. Conjure a strike of pure void lightning which comes with great range, but even greater charge-up time.
Halloween 2020 Melee.
VOID STAFF.name: VOID STAFF

CRANE.description: A special reward for a limited-time-only event. A gigantic toy replica of the Crane. Campers sold separately.
CRANE.name: CRANE

KANABO.description:
Translated to mean ''Metal Stick''.
A studded two hand war club recreation made from heavy wood and iron. It is the weapon of choice for ogres!
KANABO.name: KANABO

PADDLE.description:
A perfect weapon for paddling the competition into unsafe waters. Wouldn't recommend using it for actual boating.
Model by Shelby.
PADDLE.name: PADDLE

SWEEPER.description:
The warzone gets pretty dirty, and it looks like you were hired to clean it.
Model by ILLAXIS.
SWEEPER.name: SWEEPER

CLEMENTINE.description:
Deep from the jungles of a two-dimensional land does this instrument of interior decoration and woodcutting come from. Good speed, good damage.
By Makosushi.
Halloween 2020 Melee.
CLEMENTINE.name: CLEMENTINE
